Cool cake completely in pan on rack.  Run knife around pan sides to loosen cake.  Release pan sides.  Can be made 1 day ahead.  Cover and refrigerate.  Invert cake onto platter.  Glaze with recipe below. Freezes well.
_For the Chocolate Glaze:_

Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat.  Add cocoa and water; stir constantly until mixture thickens.  Do not boil.  Remove from heat; add vanilla.  Gradually add sugar, beating with a whisk until smooth.
To glaze cake, spread glaze around sides of cake.  Pour remaining glaze on top of cake and quickly and gently spread around.  It will set with a smooth surface.

title: Fish Fillet Over Sautéed Spinach and Tomatoes

ingredients.note: I made my own with 2 tbsp. vinegar, 1 tbsp. olive oil, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, and pepper

ingredients.ingredient: 4 6-oz. red snapper fillet, or whatever you prefer (used striped bass)

steps: Preheat broiler.  Combine mustard and dressing; stir well.  Arrange fish, skin side down, on a foil-lined baking sheet coated with no-stick cooking spray.  Brush half of mustard mixture over fish.  Broil fish for 8 minutes or until done.

While fish is cooking, combine onions and remaining mustard mixture in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat.  Cover and cook 2 minutes.  Add half of spinach; cover and cook 1 minute or until it wilts.  Add remaining spinach and tomatoes and cook again for 1 minute.  Serve fish over spinach and tomatoes.

title: Fluffy Matzo Brie
steps: Using a large bowl, pour some boiling water over matzo just enough to absorb.  Let sit for 5 minutes, stirring a bit so all is absorbed.  (If there is excess water, drain it.)  Add milk, stirring it in, and let stand 5 minutes.  Mix in eggs; season.
Heat butter in 2 extra-large skillets.  Add matzo mixture.  Fry until golden on both sides.  Serve with maple syrup, cinnamon sugar, preserves, fresh or marinated fruit, etc.

title: Feta and Sun-Dried Tomato Torta

ingredients.ingredient: 1 stick unsalted butter, cut into pieces
½ c. pesto (homemade or purchased; I used Classico brand)

steps: Combine butter, cheeses, garlic, shallot, and vermouth in food processor with metal blade and process until smooth.  Season with hot pepper sauce.
Oil a 2-cup straight-sided mold, bowl, or pate´ terrine.  Line with plastic wrap.
Put layers of ingredients (cheese mixture, tomatoes, pesto, pine nuts) in the mold in any order.  Repeat until mold is full.

Fold plastic wrap over the top and press gently to compact the layers.  Chill until firm, at least 1 hour.  Invert onto platter, remove plastic, and serve with crackers and/or breads.  Serves a crowd.

title: Ginger Hoisin Chicken Wings
steps: Combine sauce ingredients in a non-metallic bowl.  Add chicken and toss to coat each piece well.  Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour.
Place chicken on wire rack set over baking pan.  Bake at 350° until chicken is well browned and cooked through, 35 minutes.  Turn once during cooking.

Note:  I tripled sauce recipe (doubled ginger) and used 8 lbs. of wings (weight without tips).  Brushed wings with some sauce to marinate.  Brushed again before baking, again before and after turning, and once more at end.  Still had leftover sauce.  (This was about 70 pieces.)  Brushed leftover sauce on shrimp another day.

title: German Apple Cake

ingredients.ingredient: 4 c. peeled and chopped apples (~4 apples)
ingredients.note: Use somewhat sweet apples, such as honeycrisp

steps: Mix all ingredients with a spoon.  Turn into a greased baking pan.  Pan may be a Bundt pan, rectangular pan (9" x 13"), 2 loaf pans, or a fancy bake-ware pan.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
Note: I halved the recipe and baked in a dark nonstick loaf pan at 325° for 45 minutes.
_Passover variation_:  Replace flour with 1¼  cups matzo cake meal.

title: Heavenly Raspberry Brownies

ingredients.ingredient: 1½ cups raspberries (thawed and drained, if frozen)
2 tbsp. unsweetened cocoa, plus 2 tsp. for dusting

steps: Butter and flour a 9" square pan.
Melt chocolate and butter in a double boiler over barely simmering water, stirring until smooth.  Remove from heat and cool.

In a bowl with an electric mixer, beat the eggs, sugar, and vanilla at high speed until light and fluffy, 2 to 3 minutes.  Blend in the cooled chocolate mixture at low speed.  Sift in the flour, 2 tbsp. of the cocoa, baking powder, and salt.  Mix on low speed to combine, stopping once or twice to scrape the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula.

Fold in the raspberries with a rubber spatula, then scrape the batter into the prepared baking pan.  Bake at 325° for 40 to 45 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with some crumbs adhering to it.
Cool in the pan on a wire rack.  Cut into 16 squares and sprinkle with remaining 2 tsp. cocoa.  Can also sprinkle lightly with confectioner’s sugar on top of cocoa.

title: Honey-Fruit Butter

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ cup dried fruit, cut up (used figs and apricots)

steps: In a food processor, combine all ingredients.  Mix well, but make sure that you don’t puree everything.  You still want some small pieces to add to the flavor and texture.  Makes about ¾ cup.

title: Hot-and-Sour Tofu Soup
footnotes: These vegetables were rather boring. David added some canned baby corn. Might want to substitute or add something tastier. Also, there is nothing hot in this. May want to add crushed red pepper flakes.

ingredients.ingredient: 3 tbsp. rice vinegar or white vinegar
1 12- to 16-oz. pkg. firm tofu, drained and cubed

steps: In a 4-qt. pot combine broth, vinegar, soy sauce, ginger, sugar, and pepper.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 2 min.  Add mushrooms.  Return to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 2 min. more.  Add tofu, bamboo shoots, and water chestnuts.*  Return to boiling.

Meanwhile, in a small bowl stir together the cold water and cornstarch.  Stir cornstarch mixture into tofu mixture in pot.  Cook and stir until slightly thickened and bubbly.  Cook and stir for 2 min. more.  Stir in green onions.  Pour the eggs into the soup in a steady stream while stirring 2 or 3 times to create shreds.  Serve immediately.  Serves 6 (~8¼ cups).

title: Harvest Pear Crisp with Candied Ginger

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup (1 stick) chilled unsalted butter, cut into ½-inch cubes
4 pounds firm but ripe pears (6 to 7 large), peeled, cored, cut into ½-inch cubes (about 6 cups)

steps: _For topping:_ In a food processor, chop the nuts with the ginger until coarsely chopped.  Whiz in the flour, sugar, and cinnamon.  Pulse in the butter, leaving some chunks.  Add in the oats with just a couple of pulses.  Chill while preparing filling.  Can be made 1 day ahead.  Cover and keep chilled.
_For filling:_  Whisk first 3 ingredients in large bowl.  Add pears; toss.  Transfer to 13 x 9 x 2-inch oval baking dish.  Sprinkle topping over pear mixture.
Bake at 350° until topping is crisp and golden brown and juices are bubbling, about 50 minutes.  Serve warm.  Can top with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream.
Note: I halved recipe and baked in 8" x 8" square baking dish.  Served 8-10.

title: Hard-Boiled Eggs
steps: Boil water in a pot.  Add eggs with a slotted spoon.  Add 1 tbsp. white vinegar.  Boil 20-25 min.  Strain.  Put in bowl and fill with cold water.  Replace cold water as needed.  Peel when cooled.

title: Kitchen Sink Cookies

ingredients.ingredient: ½ c. finely chopped pitted dates

steps: In a large bowl, beat butter and sugar (with an electric mixer on medium speed or by hand) until light and fluffy.  Beat in eggs, vanilla, and milk.
In a small bowl, combine flour, oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.  Add to butter mixture and beat until blended.  Stir in remaining ingredients.

Drop dough (about ¼ c. each) onto ungreased cookie sheets 2 inches apart.  Bake at 350° for 12-15 minutes, just until edges begin to brown.  Cool 2 minutes on sheets, then remove to a rack and cool completely.  Makes 3 dozen.

title: Kangaroo Cookies
steps: Put the butter and two sugars into a mixing bowl.  Blend until well mixed.
Add the vanilla and mix.
Add the eggs, one at a time, blending thoroughly after each addition.
Stir the self-rising flour into the mixture.
Pour the chocolate chips in and mix.
With a knife spread evenly in an ungreased jellyroll (10½" x 15½" x 1") pan.
Bake at 350° for 25 minutes or until it is golden brown and smells heavenly.

While still warm sprinkle with confectioner's sugar, then make 8 or 9 long cuts with a knife down the length of the cookie bar and  5 long cuts across the width, then allow the bars to cool in the  pan.

title: Pasta with Sausage and Herb Cream Sauce

ingredients.ingredient: 400 mL fresh liquid cream (we used whipping cream)

ingredients.note: We used rosemary, thyme, sage and a bay leaf. Riccardo also used marjoram. Can be made with parsley, basil, or similar herbs that suit your taste.

ingredients.ingredient: pasta (we learned to make it with homemade farfalle)

steps: Remove the casings from the sausage and break up into small chunks. Coat a saute pan with 1-2 tbsp olive oil then add the sausage and cook over medium heat. Gently brown the sausage and continue to break it up into smaller pieces (a potato masher works really well!). Optionally, sprinkle a dash or two of salt over the sausage as it cooks.

Once the sausage is browned on all sides (~5 minutes), lower the heat and add the cream, then top with some fresh cracked black pepper. Cook on low to medium-low for about 10 minutes, stirring often. You'll want the heat to be enough to create tiny bubbles in order to reduce and thicken the sauce, but be careful not to use too high of a heat that the cream boils or even curdles. As you're cooking, the cream and the oil may separate and have more of an orange color, especially early on. This is ok, as long as you stir enough as the sauce thickens that it eventually combines and emulsifies properly.

Finely chop your chosen fresh herbs. The amount and variety of herbs you choose are up to your taste. We used 4 sage leaves, 2-3 sprigs of thyme and 2-3 "branches" of rosemary (by "branches" I mean pieces that go out from the center "trunk" of a rosemary sprig, not 2-3 full sprigs), all removed from their stems. Add the chopped herbs and, if using, a whole bay leaf to the cream sauce and continue to cook, stirring often. The sauce is ready when it is no longer thin and liquidy but has thickened and is fully emulsified with the oil.

While the sauce is cooking, boil water and cook the pasta according to the directions. With a slotted spoon, remove the cooked pasta from the water and place directly into the sauce. Toss to combine. Remove the pan from the heat, and stir in the freshly grated parmesan. Add in batches for best results.
Plate and serve immediately.

title: The Best Hanukkah Latkes

ingredients.ingredient: ⅓ cup white, sweet or brown rice flour (used brown)
⅓ cup oil, for frying (vegetable, safflower, or peanut)
2½ pounds Russet potatoes, peeled (~5 medium potatoes)

steps: Grate the onion and potatoes. I use a food processor with the standard shredding disc and grate the potatoes and onions together. You can also use a box grater and grate them by hand, but it will take longer and require more overall effort.

As you complete batches of grating, squeeze all the excess moisture out over a large bowl (you will want to reserve the potato starch for binding). This step is super important! Do not be lazy! The best method we've found so far is to wrap the grated potatoes in cheese cloth and squeeze. The cheese cloth will help keep the liquid from reabsorbing as soon as you let go.

Once all of the potatoes and onions are grated and squeezed, carefully pour out the liquid that you squeezed out of the potatoes. You should see the separated potato starch at the bottom. In another large mixing bowl, combine potatoes, onions, eggs and potato starch. Stir with a fork. Add the rice flour, salt and pepper and stir to combine.
Heat ⅛-inch of oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat until it shimmers but does not smoke.

Working in batches, drop a scant ¼ cup of potato mixture into the hot oil. (The latke mixture should sizzle when it hits the oil.) Using a fork or spatula, flatten the mixture a little in the pan. I fry 3-4 latkes at a time. This will ensure your oil doesn't get cold. Cold oil=greasy latkes!
Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown. Transfer to a platter covered with paper towels and serve at once.

If you are making for a large crowd and want to serve all the latkes at once, preheat the oven to 225˚ F. Line a baking sheet with paper towels and place each latke in the warm oven as it comes off the stove.
Serve latkes with applesauce, sour cream, or other desired accompaniments.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Mushrooms
footnotes: I used packaged cleaned and shredded Brussels sprouts instead.

ingredients.note: Instead of garlic powder, salt, and pepper, I used ~1¾ tsp. freshly ground garlic pepper.

steps: Preheat the oven to 400° F.
Wash the Brussels sprouts then trim the stems and cut the Brussels sprouts in half.*
Add the sprouts and mushrooms to a large bowl. Drizzle with the olive oil and season with the garlic powder, salt, and pepper. Toss to coat.
Place the Brussels sprouts and mushrooms on a rimmed baking sheet.
Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until the Brussels sprouts are tender when pierced with a knife.
If desired, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Classic Beef Meatballs

ingredients.note: Can use Italian-style bread crumbs, instead of plain + starred seasonings

steps: Heat oven to 400˚F. Line a cookie sheet with foil. Optionally, place a wire rack on the cookie sheet. Spray the rack or foil-covered sheet.

In a large bowl, mix all ingredients. Shape mixture into 24 (1.5 in) meatballs. Place about 1 inch apart on the rack or pan. To ensure even cooking, make all the balls the same size. One tip is to continually break the meat mixture into halves until you get down to the right size, then roll into balls (for 24, break in half (12), half (6), half (3), then form three even balls from what remains, and repeat).
Bake uncovered 18-22 minutes (less for extra lean meat) until temperature reaches 160˚F and no longer pink in the center.

title: Chocolate Bit Coffee Cake
footnotes: Skip this step if frosting the cake.

ingredients.note: Skip cinnamon topping and frost with favorite icing if making as a regular chocolate chip cake

steps: Grease bottom of 9" square or 11" x 7" pan.
In a large bowl, combine flour, 1 c. sugar, baking powder, salt, yogurt, vanilla, oil, eggs and chocolate chips.  Stir 70 – 80 strokes, or until well blended.  Pour into prepared pan.
Combine remaining sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over batter.*
Bake at 350° for 35 – 40 minutes or until tester comes out clean.  (If using Pyrex dish, bake at 325° for 30 – 35 minutes.)
If making as a regular chocolate chip cake, wait for it to cool, then frost with favorite flavor of icing/frosting.

title: Curried Shrimp Phyllo Cups

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. finely chopped unsalted peanuts
½ tsp. grated gingerroot or ¼ tsp. ground ginger
¼ lb. shrimp, peeled, cooked, and chopped into small chunks

steps: In a small bowl, stir together yogurt, coconut, peanuts, chutney, curry, and ginger.  Gently stir in shrimp.   Fill phyllo cups with mixture and place on cookie sheet.  Bake at 375° for ~8 minutes.

title: Banana Chocolate Chip Bread

ingredients.ingredient: ¾ tsp. grated orange or lemon zest (opt.)

steps: Blend butter, sugar, and zest until creamy.
Beat in egg and bananas.
Sift together flour, baking powder, and salt and add in 3 parts to sugar mixture, beating after each addition until smooth.  Fold in chips.
Place in greased loaf pan and bake at 350° (or 325˚ for a dark pan) for 1 hour or until done.

title: Raspberry-Cinnamon French Toast

ingredients.ingredient: 12 slices cinnamon bread, cubed (used 16-oz. Pepperidge Farm brown sugar cinnamon swirl bread, thickly sliced)

steps: In a bowl combine the eggs, milk, ¾ cup brown sugar, cinnamon, and nutmeg. Toss the bread cubes in the bowl with the egg mixture.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Toss several times to be sure the bread soaks up the eggs.

In the morning, grease a 9" x 13" baking dish and spread the bread cubes evenly in the dish.  Sprinkle the almonds over the bread mixture.  Melt the butter in a Pyrex measuring cup in the microwave (about 40 seconds) and combine with the remaining brown sugar.  Drizzle over the top.

Bake, uncovered, at 400° for 20-25 minutes.  Sprinkle with raspberries.  Bake 5-10 minutes longer or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.  (May be ready sooner, so check before adding raspberries and time it accordingly.)
Halves well into 1½-quart baking dish or 9" Cape May fluted dish.
_Apricot variation (for half-recipe):_

Cut 1¼ cups of dried California apricots in half.  Place in pot with ¾ cup of orange juice and ¾ cup of triple sec.  Bring to a boil; reduce heat and simmer until just about all of the liquid is absorbed, 30 – 60 minutes?  Place in strainer over bowl.  Save liquid in bowl to use as topping.  (It will have consistency of lemon curd.)  Separate apricots (they will be mushy) and place on a board to dry out a bit.  Place in a covered container, separating layers with wax paper.  In the morning, gently stir half of the apricots into bread cubes in batches.  After drizzling with brown sugar/butter, top with remaining apricots.  Eliminate raspberries.  Serve with leftover boiling liquid.

title: Roasted Fish with Raisins and Cinnamon

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup freshly squeezed orange juice
4 (8- to 12-ounce) whole trout, boned, or 1½ lb. salmon or other fish fillet

steps: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except fish and mix well.  (Can be made and refrigerated up to 8 hours before using.)

Place the fish flat side down in a baking dish just large enough to hold the fish.  Rub the marinade into both sides of the fish, including the cavities.  If using fish fillet with skin, place in dish skin-side down.  Pour marinade over.  Roast at 450° for about 15 minutes or until fish just begins to flake when prodded with a fork.  Transfer the fish to dinner plates.  Spoon the accumulated sauce over the fish and serve at once.

title: Chocolate Brownie Drop Cookies

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. ground pecans or almonds

steps: Melt chocolate and butter.  Add sugar.  Mix in eggs and vanilla.  Then add flour, nuts, and chocolate chunks.
Drop by large spoonful onto greased cookie sheets.  Bake at 350° for 7 – 10 minutes until just set.  (Generally need 7 min.)  Let cool at least 5 minutes.
Before serving, sprinkle with confectioner's sugar.  Makes 4-5 dozen.  Freezes  well.

title: Brownies

ingredients.ingredient: 4 oz. unsweetened chocolate, melted and cooled

steps: Cream sugar and butter.
Add eggs, one at a time, beating after each one with electric hand mixer.
Add vanilla, melted chocolate, flour, and salt; beat again with electric mixer.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into greased 9" x 13" Pyrex pan.  Bake at 350° for 25 minutes.

title: Grand Marnier Apricot Stuffing

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. sage turkey sausage (from Ardmore Farmer’s Market)
1 lb. Pepperidge Farm herb stuffing mix
1½ cups Grand Marnier (I use Triple Sec—much cheaper)

steps: Place apricots and 1 cup Grand Marnier in saucepan.  Heat to boiling.  Remove from heat and set aside.
Melt ½ cup margarine in a large skillet.  Add celery and onion and sauté for 10 minutes.  Transfer to a large bowl.

Remove casing from sausage and cut into small pieces.  Cook in same skillet, breaking it up.  Cook until done.  Remove from heat and add to celery mixture.  Add stuffing mix, apricots with liquid, and almonds.  Stir to combine.

Heat remaining ½ cup margarine and stock in small saucepan until margarine melts.  Pour over stuffing mixture and add remaining ½ cup Grand Marnier.  Stir well to moisten stuffing.  Season with thyme and pepper.
_To stuff turkey:_

Rinse 18-22 lb. turkey and pat dry. Squeeze juice from 2 oranges and use baster to sprinkle over turkey and cavities. Spoon stuffing into cavities and sew or skewer shut. Put remaining stuffing in shallow dish.
Sprinkle turkey with thyme and pepper and brush with melted margarine. Then follow turkey baking instructions.
To bake extra stuffing, cover with foil and refrigerate when made. Then remove from frig. 30 minutes before baking. Bake ~1 hour at 350˚.

title: Gorgonzola Figs with Balsamic Glaze

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup crumbled Gorgonzola cheese (~½ lb.; used picante or Valdeon)
8 thin slices prosciutto, halved widthwise (used speck)
2 tsp. minced fresh rosemary (or equivalent dried)

steps: For glaze, in a small saucepan, bring vinegar to a boil over medium heat; cook until reduced to about ¼ cup.  ~45 minutes.  (It was a lot of glaze.  Could probably make half this amount.)

Cut off the stem of each fig a little below the stem.  Use your finger (I wore a surgical glove) to push open the cut, then push your finger down into the fig, circling around to create a hollowed-out space within the fig, restoring its natural shape.  Fill with 1½ tsp. cheese.  Wrap each with a piece of prosciutto, covering the opening.  Place on a baking sheet.  Sprinkle with rosemary and pepper.
Bake at 425° for 10-12 minutes or until prosciutto is crisp.  Brush with glaze and serve warm.  Makes 16.

title: Aunt Jan's Famous Brisket

ingredients.ingredient: 5-6 lbs. brisket, cut in 2 pieces, in packet with fat on it; want meat that feels soft to the touch
2 oz Kitchen Bouquet or Gravy Master Seasoning & Browning Sauce w/o MSG
⅛ - ¼ cup red wine (orig. said ¼ with note that too much makes it bitter)
1 packet Lipton or Goodman's (KP) Onion Soup Mix
½ large bag of mini carrots (opt.)
2-3 mini red bliss potatoes per person (opt.)

steps: Season meat with garlic powder and pepper and place fat-side up in a large pan. If using 6+ lbs. cut in half if possible. (Always use one recipe per pan, even if using two briskets (or two halves) in one pan.)

Combine all other ingredients and form paste to pour over meat. Add water to make enough gravy so it's almost to the top of the pan and the brisket is almost fully immersed. Add carrots and potatoes around edges. Cook at 300˚ for ~6¼ hours. (Even a 7 lb. brisket, cut in half, came out perfect in 6:15.)

Remove from oven. Remove meat from pan and allow to cool ~1 hour. Can return pan to the oven on warm to keep the gravy warm while the meat cools. Once cool enough, slice. Return pieces to the warm gravy in the pan as you slice it. Serve once sliced!
_Tips_
Can make ahead, slice and freeze, then defrost in the frig. for 24 hours, then heat with loosely covered foil at 300˚-325˚ for 30-45 minutes until warm.

Can make a day in advance, slice, then cover with saran wrap and refrigerate. To reheat, you can microwave for 9 minutes (3 x 3 minutes, stirring in between) and/or put in warm over (200˚-250˚) covered loosely with foil for an hour before serving.
For faster cooking, you can raise the temperature (4-5 hours on 325˚, less at 350˚) but it's not recommended.

The recipe works with basically any size brisket. I've made it with a very small 2.5-3 lb. brisket as well as a full 12-13 lb. brisket. The key is to make one recipe of the sauce per pan, regardless of how much meat you use. If using a tiny brisket, just use a smaller pan. As long as there's roughly the same amount of empty space in the pan, you'll dilute with about the same amount of water, and it will all taste great.

title: Penne alla Vodka

ingredients.ingredient: 300g Tomato passata (Italian strained tomatoes or tomato puree)
100 ml Fresh liquid cream (used whipping cream)

steps: Add olive oil to large saucepan and heat over medium heat. Add chopped onions to the pan. Sweat the onions for 2-3 minutes, then add the pancetta. Allow the pancetta to cook until most or all of the fat is melted off or crisped, then add half of the vodka. The vodka should bubble and cook off the alcohol.

Once you no longer smell alcohol in the pan, add the tomato passata. Add salt and pepper to taste. Maintain a simmer, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens. This is the longest step, which should take 10-15 minutes if not longer. Keep a watchful eye and adjust the heat as needed to maintain a decent simmer without burning.
While the sauce is reducing, boil water and cook pasta according to package directions.

Once the sauce has thickened to a nice consistency, stir in the cream. Continue to maintain a low simmer so the sauce continues to thicken, but be careful not to separate or curdle the cream. Continue to reduce until the sauce has a consistency a bit thicker than you would like the final sauce to be (3-5 minutes), then stir in the other half of the vodka. Unlike the first addition of the vodka, at this step we do not want to lose all the alcohol aroma. Lower the heat and allow sauce to come together, 1-3 minutes. Taste the sauce and season with additional salt or pepper to taste.
Remove the pan from heat, add the penne pasta to the pan and toss to coat. Serve immediately.

title: Maple-glazed Brussels Sprouts

ingredients.ingredient: 4 oz. softened unsalted butter, cut into tbsp. pieces
1 c. vacuum packed chestnuts, chopped (6 oz.)
2¼ lbs. Brussels sprouts, halved (or whole baby sprouts)

steps: Heat canola oil in large skillet until shimmering. Add Brussels sprouts, salt and pepper. Cook over high heat without stirring until sprouts are browned – about 2 minutes.
Add butter and brown sugar over medium high heat. Stir occasionally until brown sugar is melted. Add maple syrup. Cook until sprouts are crisp tender.
Stir in cider vinegar. Add chestnuts and walnut oil. Cook until hot. Transfer sprouts and chestnuts into bowl.
Boil liquid over high heat until slightly thickened – about 2 minutes. Pour over Brussels sprouts and chestnuts. Serve and enjoy!

title: Hamentashen

ingredients.ingredient: ½ c. finely ground nuts (used walnuts)
Juice of ½ a lemon (1 tbsp.)

steps: _Dough:_
If you have a food processor: In food processor, combine all dough ingredients except butter and mix. Cut cold butter into pieces and add to other ingredients; mix.
By hand:  Cream softened butter and sugar.  Add egg and vanilla.  Sift flour and baking powder and stir into butter mixture.
Chill dough.
_Prune Filling - Cooking Method:_
Cook 1 lb. pitted prunes with lemon, sugar, and ½ c. water.  Chop prunes to desired consistency.  Add ½ c. finely ground nuts (she uses walnuts), juice of ½ lemon (1 tbsp.), and rind of orange.
_Apricot Filling - Cooking Method:_
Cook 1 lb. dried apricots with water and some sugar to taste over gentle heat; cut apricots.  Add ¾ c. raisins (light or dark), few grains salt, and ¾ tsp. grated lemon rind.
Stir until thick as marmalade.
_Filling - No cook method:_
Instead of cooking the fruits, you can put them in jars filled with water.  When they are soft, chop them to desired consistency in the food processor and add the remaining ingredients.
_Assembly:_
Roll dough out and cut into circles.  (Myra uses a 3" round cookie cutter.)  Place a small amount of filling in center of each circle.  Pinch dough together to make a triangle.
Bake at 375°, checking after 20 minutes.  Will probably need more time.

title: Mushrooms Florentine

ingredients.ingredient: 2 10-oz. pkgs. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained

steps: Combine spinach, onions, pepper, and margarine; spread in 10" casserole.  Sauté mushrooms in nonstick skillet sprayed w/ cooking spray until mushrooms are brown; drain.  Sprinkle ½ cup cheddar cheese over spinach.  Arrange mushrooms on top and season with garlic powder.   Cover with remaining cheese.  Can cover and refrigerate until ready to bake.  Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.
Can double and cook in 11" x 14" pan.

title: Mushroom Roll

ingredients.ingredient: 1 tbsp. plus 1 tsp. grated Parmesan cheese
½ - ¾ lb. thinly sliced smoked salmon (opt.)

steps: Grease a 10" x 15" x 1" jelly roll pan and line with parchment paper.  Melt butter and herbs in a large skillet.  Gently cook mushrooms 5-7 minutes, until softened.  Add flour and bring to a boil, stirring constantly until thick.  Remove from heat and cool slightly.

In a medium bowl, beat egg whites until stiff.  Beat egg yolks into mushroom mixture, then fold in beaten egg whites and 2 tbsp. of chopped parsley.  Pour into prepared pan and bake at 400° for 12-15 minutes.  Cool.

In a small bowl, beat Boursin cheese, cottage cheese and chives.  Sprinkle a sheet of parchment paper with remaining parsley and Parmesan cheese.  Turn savory cake out onto parchment paper and spread with cheese mixture.  Cover with a layer of salmon if using.  Roll up, jelly roll style.  (Rolled along the long side into a 15" long roll.)
To serve, cut into ½ - ¾ inch slices.

title: Mini-Reuben Appetizers

ingredients.ingredient: 1 loaf rye or pumpernickel cocktail bread
½ lb. corned beef, sliced thin

steps: Place cocktail ryes on cookie sheet in single layer. Carefully place corned beef on each slice of rye. Add 1 tablespoon sauerkraut on top of corned beef. Place a dollop of thousand island dressing on top of sauerkraut. Top with Swiss cheese.  Can cover and refrigerate at this point if you want.
Preheat oven to 350˚. Just before serving, slide cookie sheet into oven for 5-8 minutes -- just until cheese has melted.

title: Matzoh and Fig Scramble

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup dried figs, snipped (prefer black mission figs)

steps: Whisk the eggs in a medium-sized bowl (used electric beater).  Break the matzoh into small pieces and add to the eggs.  Allow it to sit for a while, tossing occasionally, so the eggs soak in and soften the matzoh.
Add the goat cheese, spooning it into the mixture in small bits.  Stir in the figs.
Melt the butter in a skillet (used 10").  Add the egg mixture, sprinkle with pepper, and scramble until cooked, about 2 minutes.  Can serve with maple syrup.
_Alternatives:_
Replace figs and goat cheese with:
•	tomatoes and feta
•	cheddar and broccoli
•	provolone and spinach

title: Mango Puree
steps: Using a food processor or blender, puree mango, chili sauce, and oil until smooth.  Season to taste with ground pepper.
Good with crab cakes.
Can be made a day ahead and refrigerated.  Bring to room temperature before serving.

title: Mango and Sour Cherry Macaroon Crumble

ingredients.ingredient: 1.5 – 2 large mangoes, peeled, pitted and cut into small chunks
1 – 1.5 cups canned pitted sour cherries, drained (used 14.5-oz. can)
½ cup almonds, lightly toasted (used sliced)
3 tbsp. unsalted butter, cut into bits
1½ cups macaroons, crumbled and left out to dry overnight (used honey nut flavor)

steps: In a small saucepan, reduce the amaretto to ½ cup over medium-high heat.
Combine the mango, sour cherries, dried cherries, nutmeg and cinnamon in a bowl.  Pour hot amaretto over the fruit and stir with a spoon to coat evenly.  Set aside to macerate for 30 minutes.
Chop macaroons and almonds in food processor.  Add butter and pulse until combined but still crumbly.
Butter a 10" ovenproof pan (used oval white quiche dish).  Spoon the fruit and accumulated juices into the pan.
If preparing in advance, cover pan.  Place crumb topping in separate container and refrigerate both.  Bring baking dish to room temperature before proceeding.
Scatter macaroon mixture evenly over the top of the fruit.  Bake at 375° for 25 – 35 minutes or until the fruit is bubbling and the top is golden brown.  Serve warm.

title: Macaroon Cheesecake #2

ingredients.ingredient: 1½ cups coconut (or other flavor) soft macaroon crumbs

steps: Mix crumbs and butter.  Press onto bottom of 8" or 9" square pan.  (Can line pan with foil, leaving overhang on all sides.  This makes is easy to lift the finished cake out of the pan for easier cutting.)
Mix cream cheese, sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended.  Add eggs; mix until blended.  Pour over crust.
Bake at 350° for 35-40 minutes or until center is almost set.  Run knife around rim of pan to loosen cake.  Cool; refrigerate 3 hours or overnight.  Cut into squares or rectangles.
Can top with sliced strawberries.

title: Lime-Glazed Fish

ingredients.ingredient: 4 salmon, tuna, marlin, or other firm fish steaks, at least 1 inch thick

steps: Grate zest from 1 lime.  Squeeze juice from both limes to measure about ⅓ cup.  In a bowl, stir juice with zest, honey, and mustard until smooth (a whisk helps).  Brush fish with lime sauce.  Grill (or broil), basting often, until done, about 5 minutes per side (3 for tuna).
Used salmon fillet and baked at 400° for about 12 minutes.  Needed to turn it near the end.

title: Lime-Honey Brush-On
steps: In a small bowl, stir together all ingredients.  Brush evenly onto chicken or fish.  Refrigerate 30 minutes.  Grill.
Makes enough for ¾ pound of chicken or fish.

title: Lemon-Strawberry Squares

ingredients.ingredient: ⅓ cup confectioners’ sugar, plus extra for dusting
8 tbsp. (1 stick) unsalted butter, cut into small pieces, well chilled
2 tbsp. sour cream (used nonfat plain yogurt)

steps: Adjust an oven rack to the lowest shelf and preheat oven to 350°.

Place 1 cup of flour, confectioners’ sugar, and butter in food processor.  Pulse until the mixture resembles coarse meal.  Add the sour cream and vanilla extract.  Process briefly until the dough is just moistened.  Press the dough evenly into the bottom and ½ inch up the sides of a 9-inch square baking pan.  Bake the crust until it is pale golden, about 20 minutes.

Mix the granulated sugar, the remaining 3 tbsp. flour, and salt in a small saucepan.  Whisk in the milk, egg yolks, lemon juice, and lemon zest.  Cook the mixture over medium heat, stirring, until it thickens, 5-7 minutes.  Remove the pan from the heat, then stir in the strawberries.  Cool slightly on a rack.

Spread the cooled custard over the crust.  Bake until the custard is set, about 30 minutes.  Remove the pan from the oven and let cool on a rack.  Dust with confectioners’ sugar and cut into 16 squares.  Cover and store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.
_Note:_  I made 1½ times the recipe and baked it in a 9" x 13" pan.

title: Layered Scrambled Eggs

ingredients.ingredient: 8 eggs, beaten (used 8 egg whites and 4 whole eggs; beat with electric mixer)
12 strips bacon, fried crisp (used 4 oz. diced pancetta)
ingredients.note: Can substitute with diced cooked shrimp

steps: _Make Cream Sauce:_  Melt butter in a non-stick pan.  Whisk in flour.  Stir over low heat until bubbly.  Slowly whisk in hot milk, and stir over medium heat until bubbly and thick.   Boil 1 minute.  Add white pepper to taste.
In a double boiler, scramble eggs, but leave moist.  Mix in Cream Sauce.  Divide between 4 greased ramekins.

Spread 2 tablespoons sour cream per ramekin.  Crumble 3 strips bacon per ramekin (or shrimp) as the third layer.  Can add layers of diced seeded tomatoes, artichoke hearts, maybe mushrooms.  Top each with 1 tablespoon each type of cheese.  I sprinkled extra cheese on each.
Bake at 350° for 15 – 20 minutes  (Baked 20 minutes.)

title: Lamb Stew with Sweet Potatoes

ingredients.ingredient: 2 lbs. lamb stew meat, cut into 1-inch cubes
2-inch stick cinnamon or ¼ tsp. ground cinnamon
3 medium carrots, cut into ½ -inch pieces (1½ cups)
1½ cups frozen pearl onions (used fresh, but it was a pain to peel them)
2 lbs. sweet potatoes, peeled and quartered

steps: Season lamb with salt and pepper.  In a 4-quart pot, brown meat, half at a time, in hot oil over medium-high heat.  Drain fat.  Return all meat to pan.  Sprinkle meat with flour, stirring to coat.  Add broth, nectar, cinnamon, garlic, cumin, cardamom, and saffron; stir to combine.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 1 hour or until meat is nearly tender.

Add carrots, onions, apricots, and prunes.  Return to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, about 30 minutes more or until vegetables are tender.  Remove stick cinnamon (if using).  Serve over Mashed Sweet Potatoes.
_Mashed Sweet Potatoes:_

In a large saucepan cook sweet potatoes, covered, in a moderate amount of lightly salted boiling water for 20 – 25 minutes or until tender; drain.  Mash with a potato masher or beat with an electric mixer on low speed.  Add butter and yogurt; mash or beat.

title: Orange-Hoisin Brush-On
steps: In a small bowl stir together hoisin sauce, five-spice powder, and enough orange juice (1 to 2 tbsp.) to thin mixture for brushing.  Brush evenly onto meat or fish during last 5 minutes of grilling or broiling.  Makes enough for 2 pounds of poultry or fish.

title: Peach Blueberry Nut Crumble

ingredients.note: May want to cut back on some of the sugar.

steps: Place fruit in a greased 9" x 13" x 2" baking dish.  Cover with the ½ cup sugar and the 2 tbsp. flour and pour on the water.
Mix the 1½ cups flour and the 1½ cups sugar together and cut in the butter.  Add the nuts and spices.  Spread crumble over the fruit.
Bake at 375° for 30 minutes or until golden and bubbly.  Can be served topped with vanilla ice cream.
Can be made several hours in advance and left at room temperature.  Heat at 200° for 10 minutes before serving.

title: Pear and Sour Cherry Tart

ingredients.ingredient: ½ c. dried cranberries or cherries (used cranberries)
8 firm-ripe Bosc or Bartlett pears (used Bartlett)
½ cup packed light brown sugar
1 teaspoon finely chopped fresh rosemary (used ~⅓ tsp. dried)

steps: _Crust:_  Crush cookies with berries in food processor until both are finely ground.  Add butter and process to combine.  Press into bottom and up sides of a 10" tart pan.  Chill.

_Filling:_  Peel pears and cut into ½-inch pieces.  Cook pears, cherries, brown sugar, and rosemary in a 4- to 5-quart heavy pot over moderate heat, stirring, until pears are tender, about 20 minutes.  Stir together lemon juice and cornstarch in a small cup and stir into pear mixture.  Cook, stirring, 1 minute, or until thickened.  Transfer filling to a bowl and cool completely.  (Filling may be made 3 days ahead and chilled, covered.  Bring to room temperature before proceeding.)
_Topping:_  In a small bowl, combine flour and sugar; cut in butter until crumbly.  Stir in almonds.

Preheat oven to 425°F and place a large baking sheet in middle of oven.  Spoon filling into tart shell, smoothing top.  Sprinkle topping over filling.  Bake tart on preheated baking sheet in middle of oven until done.  Check after 30 minutes.  (I baked it 40 minutes.)  Cool tart in pan on a rack at least 1 hour.
Tart may be made 1 day ahead and kept, covered, at room temperature.
_Note:_ There was a lot of filling, so I mounded it high.  For a more typical tart you could probably make half to three-quarters the filling recipe.

title: Nova and Chutney Pickups

ingredients.ingredient: Trader Joe’s Mango/Ginger Chutney (or your choice chutney)

steps: Cut the Nova to fit on each cracker.  Stir a bit of curry powder, according to your taste, into the chutney.  Spoon chutney over Nova on each cracker.  Top each with a dollop of crème fraiche.

title: Pear-Cranberry Upside-Down Cake

ingredients.ingredient: 3 tbsp. light butter or margarine, at room temperature
⅓ c. packed light brown sugar
2 firm-ripe Bartlett pears, peeled, quartered, and cored, and each quarter cut lengthwise into 3 wedges (or may halved, then quartered)
1 c. fresh or frozen cranberries, not thawed

steps: In a 10-inch cast-iron skillet or other heavy 10-inch ovenproof skillet, melt 1 tbsp. light butter over medium heat.  Brush melted butter to coat bottom and halfway up sides of skillet.  Remove from heat.  Sprinkle bottom evenly with brown sugar.  In bottom of skillet, arrange pear wedges, rounded side down, like spokes of a wheel, leaving center open.  Fill in center and spaces between pears with cranberries.

In a small bowl, stir together flour, baking powder, and salt.  In a medium bowl, with electric mixer on medium speed, beat egg whites until foamy.  Gradually beat in ¼ c. granulated sugar.  Increase mixer speed to medium-high and beat until stiff and glossy peaks form.

In a large bowl, combine remaining 2 tbsp. light butter, remaining ¼  c. granulated sugar, the egg yolk, and vanilla.  With electric mixer on medium speed, beat until blended, about 2 minutes.  Beat in half the milk.  Reduce mixer sped to low and beat in half the flour mixture.  Beat in remaining milk, the orange zest, and then remaining flour mixture.  Stir in spoonful of beaten egg whites to lighten mixture.  Gently fold in remaining whites in 2 additions, just until blended.  Pour batter evenly over pears in skillet.

Bake at 350° until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean, 35-40 minutes.  Transfer skillet to wire rack to cool for 3 minutes.  Invert serving plate over skillet.  Using mitts to protect your hands, carefully invert cake onto plate.  Remove skillet.  Spread any glaze remaining in skillet over pears.  Let cake cool completely.

title: Pesach Chocolate Truffle Cake

ingredients.ingredient: 12 oz. semisweet chocolate, chopped, divided (used chocolate chips)
1½ cups butter, cut into pieces, divided

steps: Grease a 9" round pan.  If not using one with rotating sweep, line bottom with parchment and grease again.
Melt 6 oz. semisweet chocolate with bittersweet chocolate, 1 cup butter, sugar, and cream, stirring frequently until smooth.  Cool slightly and stir in vanilla.
Beat eggs at medium speed with electric mixer 1 minute.  Beat chocolate mixture into eggs until smooth.  Pour batter into pan and tap gently on work surface to break any large air bubbles.

Place pan into larger pan (used 10" x 14").  Pour water into larger pan, filling about ¾ of an inch up sides of cake pan to create water bath.  Bake at 350° for 25 to 30 minutes until edges of cake are set but center is still soft.  Remove pan from water bath.  Cool.  Cake may sink a little in center and may crack slightly.
Turn cake over onto cake plate.  If freezing, line plastic board with plastic wrap and turn cake onto board instead.  Remove pan and paper.

Melt remaining chocolate and butter, stirring until smooth for glaze.  Use a spatula to spread over sides, then pour over top and spread.  It will be runny but keep smoothing while it sets.  Clean excess glaze from plate/board.

If freezing, place board in freezer until cake is frozen.  Then run a thin sharp knife around bottom edges to loosen.  Bring up plastic and wrap tightly.  Remove board and return frozen cake to freezer.  To serve, remove plastic and place on serving platter.

title: Pistachio and White Fish Salad

ingredients.ingredient: 4 tbsp. apple cider vinegar or rice-wine vinegar
½ Granny Smith apple, cored and cut into thin bite-size pieces
ingredients.note: I replaced the apples with ½ cup fresh figs, sliced crosswise into discs

steps: In a jar with a tight lid, combine the vinegar, raspberry preserves, olive oil, and black pepper.  Add the cranberries.  Shake the container well to coat.  Let stand for 10 minutes.

Divide the salad greens between six plates.  Top each one with the shredded carrots, then the apples, then the fish.  Spoon the cranberries on top and sprinkle with the pistachios.  Drizzle the dressing over the top of each serving.
I doubled the recipe and served it on a large platter.  I tossed the salad greens with some of the dressing first, then made the layers, and drizzled more dressing over the top.  Served 12-15.

title: Plum Crisp

ingredients.ingredient: 1.75 – 2 lbs. Italian prune plums, pitted and quartered
⅓ c. packed light brown sugar
¼ c. packed light brown sugar
1 tbsp. fruit juice, preferably apple (used apricot nectar)

steps: Lightly coat a 9" x 9" x 2" square baking pan with cooking spray.  (Used ceramic quiche dish—round in CM, oval in WW.)
_Make filling:_  In a large bowl toss filling ingredients.  Transfer to prepared baking pan.

_Make topping:_  In a medium bowl, stir together oats, flour, brown sugar, baking powder, and salt until no lumps of brown sugar remain.  In a small bowl, stir together oil and juice.  Drizzle juice mixture over oat mixture and toss until evenly moistened  and crumbly.  Press together small handfuls of oat mixture to  make streusel-like pieces and arrange on top of filling to cover.  Sprinkle evenly with almonds.
Bake at 375° until topping is browned and filling is bubbly, 40 – 45 minutes.  Cool slightly on wire rack.  Serve warm with vanilla ice cream.

title: Passover Chocolate Chip Brownies

ingredients.ingredient: ¾ c. matzo cake meal (plus extra for dusting the pan)
10 tbsp. (1¼ sticks) Kosher-for-Passover unsalted margarine or butter

steps: Preheat oven to 350˚.  Grease an 8" x 8" pan.  Sprinkle with matzo cake meal.
Melt margarine in medium saucepan over low heat.  Remove from heat; add ¾ c. chocolate chips and stir until they are melted.  Put into large mixing bowl.
Whisk in the sugar and vanilla.
Test temperature of chocolate.  It should be lukewarm.  If it is not, let it stand until it is.
Whisk eggs and add to chocolate mixture, constantly whisking until they are well mixed in.  Using a wooden spoon, stir in matzo cake meal until blended.  Add remaining ¾ c. chocolate chips.

Spread in prepared pan.  Bake 25-30 minutes.  (They should be VERY moist; don’t overbake.  They will continue to bake a bit as they cool in the pan.)  Cool completely on wire rack before cutting into bars.  Freezes well.

title: Fish Fillets with Apricot and Lime

ingredients.ingredient: 3 tbsp. chopped fresh mint or basil (used mint)
⅓ cup freshly squeezed lime juice (~3 limes)
1½ lbs. fish fillets, bones and skin removed (used halibut; have also used striped bass, aka rockfish)

steps: In a bowl, combine all ingredients except fish.  Can cover and refrigerate up to 8 hours.
Line a baking pan with foil and spray with cooking spray.  Put fish in pan with the side that had the skin facing up.  Brush with marinade; turn fillets over.  Can cover and refrigerate.
Remove from frig 30 minutes before baking.  Generously brush fillets with marinade 15 minutes before baking.  Boil remaining marinade in small pot.

Bake at 400° for about 12 – 15 minutes.  Transfer to platter and pour some cooking liquid over.  Can garnish with strips of fresh or dried apricots.  Serve with boiled marinade.  Can also boil down pan drippings.
_Notes:_
[1] I doubled the marinade recipe and used 6 lbs. fish fillets to serve 37 guests at potluck dinner.  Disappeared!
[2] Original recipe said to grill the fish.

title: Egg Soufflé

ingredients.ingredient: 6 eggs (used 4 whole eggs and 4 egg whites)
2 cups (8 ounces or 250 grams) grated cheese
½ stick (2 ounces or 60 grams) butter, melted

ingredients.note: Can substitute with ¾ lbs. cut-up shrimp.

steps: Preheat oven to 350°.  Grease a 9x9 inch casserole dish.  (Used 7x11 inch dish.)
Mix flour, baking powder, salt, and pepper.  Set aside.
Sauté onion and mushrooms.  Set aside.
Beat eggs (used mixer).  Add all cheeses, butter, onion and mushrooms.  Mix well.
Add flour mixture.
Pour into casserole dish.
Place slices of tomato on top and push in slightly.  Sprinkle with parsley and any extra cheese.
Bake at 350° for 40 minutes.

title: Eggs Colorado
source: The Queen Victoria Cookbook by Anna Marie McMain
footnotes: May be prepared in advance, covered and refrigerated until ready to bake.  If prepared in advance bring to room temperature before baking or add 15 minutes to baking time.
Halves well.  Use 1½-quart baking dish.
steps: Lightly spray a 9" x 13" baking dish with non-stick pan coating.
Combine all ingredients except additional salsa and sour cream/yogurt in a large mixer bowl.  Mix well and pour into prepared baking dish.
Bake at 350° for 1 hour or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean.  Serve with fresh warmed salsa and sour cream/yogurt on the side.**

title: European Fruit Pudding
source: Fannie’s Favorites, Holiday by Fannie Fertik

ingredients.ingredient: ½ c. dried peaches and/or pears

ingredients.note: Low Cholesterol Version: 2 whole eggs + 6 egg whites

steps: Soak apricots, prunes and peaches in hot water for about 1 hour and then drain.  Cut fruit into pieces.  Beat eggs, add oil and then sugar.  Add cake meal.  Mix thoroughly.  Add fruit.  With wooden spoon mix thoroughly.  Turn into greased 9" x 12" baking pan.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.  Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until browned on top.  Serve with meat or fowl or as a dessert.
Can be prepared in advance, then baked later.

title: Drunken Crab Frittata
source: Annapolis Bed and Breakfast Association, Favorite Recipes, Volume 2; recipe from Peninsula House

ingredients.ingredient: 8 eggs (used 4 whole eggs and 8 egg whites)
1 – 1½ cups crabmeat (used jumbo lump, ~ ½ lb.)

steps: Combine all ingredients except parsley and paprika.
Bake in a well-greased cast iron skillet (used 12") at 350° for one hour.  Garnish with parsley and paprika.
I have also quickly cooked 1½ cups of shrimp and cut them into pieces to use in place of crab.

title: Plum Crumble Squares

ingredients.note: Can use ½ cup store-bought ground almonds and ½ cup slivered or sliced almonds.

ingredients.ingredient: 6 large plums, sliced, then each slice halved

steps: Lightly butter a 9" x 13" baking pan.

_To make the crust and topping:_  If not using ground almonds, place ½ cup of the almonds in a food processor and process until finely ground.  Add flour, confectioner’s sugar, baking powder, and ground ginger, and combine briefly.  Add cold butter and pulse to make coarse crumbs.  Turn dry mix into a large bowl and add crystallized ginger.

Combine egg, egg yolk, and vanilla.  Gradually add to dry mix, tossing with a fork and your fingers until mixture begins to come together.  Set ⅓ of mixture aside and press remainder into the prepared pan.  Prick all over with a fork, then refrigerate 15-20 minutes.  Bake at 350° for 18-20 minutes until lightly golden.  Set aside to cool.

Meanwhile, combine the filling ingredients.  Spread on baked crust and sprinkle reserved crumbs and remaining almonds on top.  Bake 45-50 minutes until plums are bubbling around a golden topping.  Cut into squares.

title: Pomegranate Poinsettia
steps: Combine first 3 ingredients in a shaker with ice.  Strain into champagne flute.  Slowly add the sparkling wine, stirring gently.

Can also combine the first 3 ingredients in a pitcher, using equal parts of the first 3 ingredients.  Chill well.  To serve, stir well and pour mixture into champagne flute. Top with equal amount of sparkling wine.  Stir gently.

I mixed 2 cups each of the first 3 ingredients and shook mixture in a covered pitcher.  Poured half of the mixture into a punch bowl and slowly added a bottle (750 ml) of Prosecco.  Gently stirred and served with punch glasses.  When this was gone, I repeated with the other half of the mixture and another bottle of Prosecco.  Served at potluck dinner with 36 people and other beverages.

title: Pumpkin Cake

ingredients.ingredient: 2 cups of pumpkin (Buy a large can and measure the two cups.)

steps: Cream the eggs and sugar using an electric hand mixer.  Add the oil and the pumpkin.  Mix the dry ingredients together in a small bowl and add in thirds, mixing well.  Fold in the chocolate chips.

Generously grease a bundt or tube pan with cooking spray.  Pour batter into pan.  Bake at 350° for 60-70 minutes until toothpick comes out clean.  Don't overbake.  (I checked at 60 min. and it was definitely done.  Used dark pan.  Maybe should reduce temperature or check it earlier, as it was only somewhat moist.)

Cool in the pan on a wire rack about 20 minutes.  Run a thin knife or spatula around the pan to make sure it doesn't stick to the sides or middle.  Turn out onto a cake plate.  Put a cake plate lid on it so the top stays moist instead of crisping up.
After it cools, it freezes beautifully.
If you want, you can drizzle with the following glaze:

In a small saucepan over low heat, blend chips, butter, and milk, stirring constantly until chips melt.  Remove from heat.  Stir in powdered sugar until smooth.  Add additional milk if necessary for glazing consistency.

title: Quick Chicken Soup

ingredients.ingredient: 4½ qts. boxed organic low-salt, low-fat, gluten-free chicken broth (used Trader Joe’s)
1 pkg. fresh soup greens (onion, carrots, turnip, parsnip, leek, parsley, dill, celery—bought at Giant)

steps: Peel and coarsely chop vegetables.  Tie herbs together with string.  Add all to broth.  Slowly simmer, partially covered, for 45 minutes.  Strain out the solids.  Season with  pepper and salt, if needed.
If making matzo balls, use some of the broth to cook them.  Remove balls and strain broth.  Add remaining broth.

title: Chocolate and Pear Bread Pudding

ingredients.ingredient: 1 8-oz. pkg. cream cheese, softened (I used reduced-fat)
4 medium pears, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced (2 cups) (I used bosc pears)
⅓ c. miniature semisweet chocolate pieces (I threw in more–I probably used ~½ to ⅔ cup total)
1½ c. milk, half-and-half, or light cream

steps: In a large mixing bowl beat cream cheese, the ⅔ c. sugar, lemon peel, vanilla, the ¼ tsp. nutmeg, and the ¼ tsp. cinnamon with an electric mixer on low speed till smooth.  Beat in eggs, 1 at a time, beating just till combined after each addition.  With a large spoon, stir in milk, half-and-half, or light cream; bread; pears; and chocolate pieces.  Pour mixture into an ungreased 2-qt. square baking dish, stirring gently to distribute chocolate pieces.

In a small bowl combine the 1 tsp. sugar, the ⅛ tsp. nutmeg, and the ⅛ tsp. cinnamon.  Sprinkle over pear mixture.  Place dish in a 13x9x2-inch baking pan; set on oven rack.  Pour hot water in the 13x9x2-inch baking pan to a depth of 1 inch.  Bake in a 350° oven about 45 minutes or till a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.  Serve warm or cool.

title: Mocha Fudge Brownies

ingredients.ingredient: 1 14-oz. can sweetened condensed milk (I used non-fat)
½ c. chopped pecans (I left these out)

steps: _Crust:_ Preheat oven to 350°.  Mix ingredients with a food processor or a pastry blender until crumbly.  Press mixture evenly on the bottom of a 9x13-inch pan.  Bake for 12 to 15 minutes.

_Filling:_ Dissolve coffee in hot water.  Combine remaining filling ingredients with an electric mixer or food processor.  Stir in dissolved coffee.  Spread over baked crust.  Bake for 15 minutes, or until center is set.  Cool.

_Frosting:_ In a saucepan, melt butter.  Stir in cocoa and remove from heat.  Dissolve coffee in hot water.  Add to butter mixture and stir in confectioners’ sugar.  Beat until smooth with an electric mixer.  Spread over brownies.  Cool and cut into squares.

title: Ranch Chicken Chowder

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast halves, cut into bite-size pieces
ingredients.note: Can use cooked chicken or turkey.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 sweet potato, peeled and sliced (~ 8 oz.)
1 cup whole corn kernels (canned, frozen, fresh)

steps: If using raw chicken, in a large saucepan cook chicken, half at a time, in hot butter over medium heat until no longer pink.  Remove chicken with a slotted spoon, reserving drippings in saucepan.

Add sweet potato, onion, Serrano peppers, coriander, and cumin to saucepan; add half of the chicken broth.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, about 20 minutes or until vegetables are very tender.  Cool slightly.

Place sweet potato mixture in a blender container.  Cover and blend until smooth.  Return mixture to saucepan; add chicken/turkey, remaining broth, and corn.  Heat through.  If desired, garnish with snipped fresh cilantro and sour cream.  Makes 5-6 servings (~3½ cups).

title: Whiskey-Mustard Marinade

ingredients.ingredient: ½ tsp. bottled hot pepper sauce

steps: In small bowl stir together all ingredients.  Pour over seafood or fish.  Turn to coat seafood or fish.  Marinate in frig. at least 2 hours or up to 4 hours, turning occasionally.  Drain seafood or fish.  Grill until done.  Can boil marinade on stove and brush on seafood and vegetables.  Makes enough for 2½ pounds of seafood or fish.
Made ¼ of recipe with about ¾ pound shrimp.  Had extra marinade.

title: Pistachio and Pomegranate-stuffed Black Mission Figs
steps: Combine nuts and syrup.  Cut stem from each fig.  Using your finger (wear glove), push into stem opening and stretch to create hollow pocket.  Stuff with nut mixture.  Place in a hot oven or microwave until figs are just warmed.

title: Very-Berry Crisp

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup firmly packed brown sugar
1 Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and thinly sliced (opt.)

steps: Butter a shallow 2-quart casserole or 10" ovenproof pie pan.  (Used 10" square Corningware baking dish.)  In a medium bowl combine the flour, sugar, and cinnamon.  Cut in the butter until mixture is crumbly.  Mix in the oats.

Spread the fruit in the prepared baking dish (apples on bottom if using) and sprinkle topping over fruit.  (Can cover and refrigerate until later.)  Bake at 350° until the topping is browned and berries are bubbly, about 40 minutes.  Serve warm or at room temperature with ice cream or lightly sweetened whipped cream.

title: Three Fruit Chutney

ingredients.ingredient: 1 Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and chopped

steps: Combine all ingredients in a saucepan.
Bring to boiling.  Reduce heat and simmer, uncovered, 15-20 minutes, stirring frequently.
Spoon into container and refrigerate.  Makes 2 cups.
Can be frozen.

title: Thai-Style Shrimp Soup

ingredients.ingredient: 2 tbsp. minced fresh lemongrass or 1½ tsp. finely shredded lemon peel
1 small zucchini, cut into matchstick-size pieces (~1½ cups; ~½ lb.)
12 oz. small shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps: In a saucepan bring broth to boiling.  Add zucchini, green onion, ginger, lemongrass, and crushed red pepper.  Return to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, for 3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add coconut milk and heat gently.  Add shrimp and heat through (do not boil) until shrimp turn pink.  Top with shredded basil.

title: Thai Peanut Soup
footnotes: I stirred in some bite-sized pieces of cooked chicken at the end and heated through.  I have also stirred in cut-up raw shrimp and broccoli cut into tiny florets.

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup finely chopped red sweet pepper, divided

steps: In a 2-quart saucepan cook onion, celery, and ¼ cup of the red sweet pepper in hot butter over medium heat about 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender, stirring occasionally.  Stir in the flour, lemon peel, and ground red pepper.  Add broth and coconut milk all at once.  Cook and stir until the mixture is slightly thickened and bubbly.  Cook and stir for 1 minute more.  (Mixture may look curdled.)

Stir peanut butter and soy sauce into mixture in saucepan; cook and stir until well mixed and heated through.  To serve, ladle soup into bowls.  Top with remaining chopped red sweet pepper and peanuts.*

title: Thai Chicken-Coconut Soup
footnotes: If using cooked chicken or turkey, cut into bite-size pieces.  Combine all ingredients in saucepan except turkey and coconut milk.  Brought to boiling; reduced heat.  Simmered, covered, for 10 minutes.  Add meat at end with coconut milk.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. skinless, boneless chicken breast halves or thighs
ingredients.note: Can use cooked chicken or turkey.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 large red or yellow sweet pepper, cut into thin strips (1 cup)
3 green onions, sliced into ½" pieces

steps: Cut chicken into bite-size strips.*  In a 4-quart saucepan stir together chicken, broth, fish sauce, lemon juice, ginger, and cumin.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, for 10 minutes.

Sir in broccoli, sweet pepper, jalapeno pepper, green onions, and cilantro.  Return to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, covered, about 10 minutes more or until vegetables are tender.  Add coconut milk; heat through but do not boil.

title: Gigi’s Strawberry Mousse Mold

ingredients.ingredient: 2 10-oz. packages frozen strawberries in heavy syrup, thawed

steps: Drain strawberries, reserving 1½ cups juice.  Heat juice.  Add jello to juice; cool.  Add strawberries and marshmallows.  Whip cream until stiff; gently fold into jello mixture.  Put into molds and chill several hours until firm.  To unmold, run knife around edges of each mold.  Dip outside of each mold pan in bowl or sink of hot water for 15 seconds; remove from water.  (Be careful not to submerge mold.)  Put serving dish on top of mold and flip.  If it doesn’t come out, put pan in water again until it loosens.  Makes 2 molds (1 average, 1 small).
Note:  You can halve this recipe for 1 average-sized mold.

title: Strawberry Chocolate Tart

ingredients.ingredient: 3 tbsp. finely chopped chocolate, sweet or semisweet (used mini-chop food processor to chop)
¾ cup finely chopped walnuts (used walnut meal 1st time, almond meal 2nd time)
3 tbsp. Kirsch (used peach schnapps 1st time, crème de cassis 2nd time)
3 tbsp. red currant jelly (used fig jam 2nd time)
1 tbsp. Kirsch (used peach schnapps 1st time, crème de cassis 2nd time)
1½ pints strawberries, washed, stemmed and dried (or 2 pints of raspberries)

steps: _Crust:_  Combine the flour, salt, and brown sugar.  With a pastry blender or 2 knives, cut in the butter.  Stir in the chocolate and nuts.  Mix the vanilla and water and add to the crumbs.  Work the mixture with your hands to combine.  With floured fingers, push the mixture into a 9" or 10" false-bottom tart pan, covering the bottom and sides.  Bake at 350° for 20-25 minutes (baked 23 min. for 9" pan, 20 min. for 10" pan).  Cool completely.
_Filling:_  Melt chocolate in a double boiler.  Add melted butter and Kirsch.  Whisk quickly and thoroughly until smooth.  Add confectioners’ sugar and water, continuing to whisk until smooth.
Spread warm filling into tart shell.  Place berries, tips up, over the warm filling in a circular pattern, working from the outside in until the surface is covered.
_Glaze:_  Whisk jelly and Kirsch together over medium heat until smooth.
Brush warm glaze over berries, coating them evenly.  Refrigerate tart for 2 hours.  Remove from refrigerator 45 minutes before serving.

title: Spinach and Artichoke Fondue

ingredients.ingredient: ⅓ cup artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps: Combine the cheeses in a bowl and sprinkle with the flour. Toss to evenly coat, set aside.
Pour cooking wine and garlic into a pot and cook over medium-high heat. Once it starts to boil add the spinach and artichokes, stir until the spinach wilts.
Stir in the cheeses and keep stirring until the cheese is stringy and melted completely. Transfer to a fondue pot, or keep in pot on low heat until ready to serve.
Serve with your choice of dipping ingredients.

title: Skewered Steak with Guava-Soy Glaze and Grilled Pineapple
footnotes: Original recipe is supposed to serve 4 as an entrée or 8 as an appetizer.  I made ¾ of the recipe and it easily served 4.  There was a lot of leftover glaze.
I also made ½ recipe of glaze and used 5 boneless chicken thighs, cut into strips.  Skewered with zucchini.  Served 3 generously, with a bit of leftover glaze.

ingredients.ingredient: 2 lbs. top round beef, 1½ to 2 inches thick (1½ lbs.)
1½ tbsp. cornstarch (1 tbsp. + ⅜ tsp.) dissolved in 1 tbsp. water (2¼ tsp.)
Freshly cracked black pepper to taste
½ pineapple, sliced into 4 rounds 1 inch thick, peel left on
½ c. guava juice (or pineapple juice (3 oz.)
¼ c. packed brown sugar (3 tbsp.)
¼ c. lime juice (about 2 limes) (3 tbsp.)

steps: Cut steak against the grain into 16 2-ounce slices, pound it lightly, thread it onto skewers, and sprinkle it lightly with freshly cracked black pepper.

_Make the glaze:_  In a small saucepan, combine the soy sauce, guava juice, brown sugar, vinegar, and ginger.  Bring the mixture to a boil over medium-high heat, reduce the heat to low, stir in the cornstarch-water mixture, and simmer for 5 minutes.  Remove from heat, add the lime juice, and mix well.

Over a very hot grill, cook the skewered meat for 2 minutes per side, brushing the glaze on each side for the final 30 seconds of cooking.  At the same time, grill the pineapple slices for 2-3 minutes per side, brushing each side with glaze for the last 15 seconds or so.  Remove the pineapple from the grill, cut it into thick wedges, and serve with the grilled steak skewers.**

title: Shrimp with Feta Cheese

ingredients.ingredient: 1 17-oz. can Italian plum tomatoes, well drained

ingredients.note: The sauce was watery after adding the clam juice.  I would probably eliminate it.

steps: Sprinkle shrimp with lemon juice and set aside.  Sauté onion, parsley, and garlic in hot oil until soft.  Add plum tomatoes and break up with a spoon.  Cook over low heat, stirring occasionally, about 20 minutes.
Add (clam juice,) oregano and pepper.  Cook 5 minutes longer.  Turn into shallow 1½-quart casserole.

In large skillet, sauté shrimp in margarine, stirring 5 minutes or until they turn pink.  With a slotted spoon, place shrimp over tomato mixture and top with tomato slices.  Pour wine over top and then sprinkle with feta cheese.
Bake at 450° for 20 minutes.  Serve over orzo or rice.

title: Shrimp Skewers with Curried Mango Sauce

ingredients.ingredient: ⅓ cup peeled and chopped English cucumber

steps: Peel shrimp, leaving tails intact.  Devein shrimp, if desired.
Toss together shrimp, chili powder, salt, and olive oil in a large bowl.  Thread 5 shrimp onto each skewer, bending each shrimp to pass through skewer twice.
_Curried Mango Sauce:_ Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth, stopping once to scrape down sides.  Makes 1 cup.

Grill, without grill lid, over high heat (400° to 500°) 4 to 5 minutes or just until shrimp turn pink, turning once.  Serve warm with Curried Mango Sauce.  Garnish with lime wedges.  Serves 6 as an entrée, 8-10 as an hors d’oeuvre.

title: Shrimp Bisque

ingredients.ingredient: 1 c. shredded peeled apple (used Granny Smith)
1 tsp. chopped fresh dill (or ⅓ tsp. dried)
1 lb. small shelled shrimp, rinsed (or larger shrimp cut in bite-sized pieces)

steps: In a covered saucepan, sauté the onions and apples in the oil for ~10 minutes, until the onions are translucent.  Sprinkle in the flour and cook, stirring, for a minute or two.  Then stir in the stock, lemon juice and peel, curry powder, dill, white pepper, and wine.  Simmer, covered, for ~5 minutes, until the mixture thickens slightly.  Add the half-and-half.

Remove lemon peel.  In a food processor or blender, puree the soup and then return to the pot.  Add the shrimp and simmer gently just until the shrimp turn pink.  Be careful not to overcook the shrimp or they will become tough.  Serves 4 as a main dish, 6 as a first course.

title: Shrimp and Asparagus Soup

ingredients.ingredient: 12 oz. medium shrimp, peeled and deveined, or bay scallops
1 lb. asparagus spears, trimmed and cut into bite-sized pieces
1 cup fresh enoki or sliced shiitake mushrooms

steps: In a large saucepan (used 4-qt.) combine the broth, wine, cilantro, lemon zest, and pepper.  Bring to boiling.  Add scallops (if using), asparagus, shiitake mushrooms (if using), and green onions.  Return to boiling; reduce heat.  Simmer, uncovered, for 3 minutes.  Add shrimp (if using).  Simmer 2 minutes or until asparagus is tender and seafood is opaque.
Remove saucepan from heat.  Stir in the enoki mushrooms (if using) and lemon juice.

title: Sex on the Beach

ingredients.ingredient: ½ ounce crème de cassis (8 oz.)
2 ounces orange juice, pineapple juice or both (32 oz.)

steps: Pour all the ingredients into a cocktail shaker with ice cubes.  Shake well.  Strain into a highball glass.  Garnish with the orange slice.  Makes 1 serving.
To make a party punch, use amounts listed in parentheses. Makes ~30 glasses.

title: Salmon en Croute

ingredients.ingredient: ½ cup snipped fresh parsley, packed (used cilantro)
¼ cup snipped fresh dill, packed
2 tbsp. Italian salad dressing (used balsamic vinaigrette)
8 oz. salmon fillet, skinned, boned and cut in ¾-inch pieces

steps: With a serrated knife, slice the bread horizontally about ¼ way down.  You won’t need this top slice.  Scoop out the soft bread from the inside of the loaf, leaving about ½-inch shell.  Process the soft bread (makes about 2 cups crumbs).  Set aside.
In a small bowl, mash the margarine, parsley, dill and salad dressing with a fork.  Set aside.
Toss the salmon and mushrooms with the lemon-pepper seasoning and garlic powder.

To assemble:  Spread half the margarine-herb mixture inside the bread shell, coating the bottom and sides.  Add the salmon and mushrooms, and spread evenly over the herb mixture.  Top with the remaining margarine-herb mixture, spreading over the filling.  Completely cover with a thick layer of breadcrumbs, pressing down with hands.  Spray crumbs with cooking spray.

Place on a baking sheet and bake at 400° for 45 minutes, until topping is deep brown.  (If the topping gets too dark, cover loosely with aluminum foil.)  Let the loaf rest for 10 minutes before cutting into thick slices.  Serves 6.

_Notes:_  I doubled recipe and used one 2-pound loaf of Tuscany bread (from Genuardi’s).  Cooked perfectly using above timing and served 10.  However, the thick crispy crust made slicing difficult.  Some possible solutions to try:
•	Remove more bread, making the shell thinner, perhaps ¼ inch thick.  In this case, you might want to use a bit more salmon.
•	Cover crust with aluminum foil.  (Leave top exposed.)
•	Use a bread with a softer crust.  (The French bread called for in the recipe may have been less dense than Tuscany.)

title: Rosemary Potatoes with Caramelized Shallots and Mushrooms

ingredients.ingredient: 5 – 7 shallots, peeled, sliced crosswise, and separated into rings
2 lbs. baby red potatoes, as small as possible (can be mixed with tiny white-skinned and purple-skinned potatoes, unpeeled)
3 tbsp. olive oil plus extra for brushing
Salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: In a skillet, melt butter over medium-high heat.  Add shallots and mushrooms and sauté for 5 minutes.  Add wine and sauté for 5 minutes longer or until shallots and mushrooms are soft and golden.  Remove from heat.

Scrub potatoes and place in large bowl.  Brush with olive oil.  Sprinkle with rosemary, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.  Toss in shallots and mushrooms and mix.  Place into 9" x 13" baking pan.  Drizzle with 3 tablespoons olive oil.
Roast, uncovered, at 400°, stirring occasionally, for 1 to 1½ hours or until potatoes are soft when tested with a knife.

title: Roasted Fish with Dried Fruit Glaze

ingredients.ingredient: ⅓ cup dried Bing cherries (used golden raisins)
2 tbsp. coarsely chopped fresh mint, divided
Crushed red pepper flakes or freshly ground black pepper

steps: In a saucepan, combine the apricots, cranberries, cherries (or raisins), ginger, ⅓ cup of wine, and 1 tbsp. of the mint and mix well.  Place over medium heat and bring to a simmer.  Cover and cook for about 10 minutes, until the fruit softens.  (The fruit can be covered and refrigerated for up to 8 hours before using.)

Place the fish flat side down in a baking dish.  Sprinkle the fish with pepper flakes.  Arrange the fruit on top of and around the fish.  Pour the remaining ⅓ cup wine around the fish.  Place in the oven at 350° and roast for about 12 minutes, until fish is done.  Transfer to plates.  Squeeze the lemon wedges over the fish.  Garnish with the remaining 1 tbsp. mint and serve.

title: Roasted Brussels Sprouts with Cranberry Brown Butter

ingredients.ingredient: ½ lb. fresh or thawed frozen cranberries
2 sticks (½ lb.) unsalted butter (maybe try less)

steps: On 2 large rimmed baking sheets, toss the brussels sprouts with the oil and season with pepper.  Roast at 400° for 30-40 minutes, stirring halfway through, until the sprouts are tender and browned in spots.
Meanwhile, in a small saucepan, combine the cranberries, maple syrup, ginger and orange zest.  Cook over moderately low heat, stirring, until the cranberries break down and thicken, about 10 minutes.

In a medium skillet, cook the butter over moderately high heat until deep golden, about 4 minutes.  Remove from the heat, add the shallot and thyme and stir into the cranberry sauce.  Transfer the butter to a bowl; add the brussels sprouts and toss.
Note:  The cranberry brown butter can be refrigerated for up to 3 days.  Gently reheat the butter before tossing with the brussels sprouts.

title: Raspberry Salad
footnotes: 10 oz. spring mix and ½ recipe of dressing works well.  Serves ~12.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 pound spring mix or baby spinach

steps: Combine topping ingredients in a large frying pan.  Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until sugar melts to a golden brown and coats almonds, about 5-8 minutes.  Turn out onto a square of greased foil.  Cool, then break up into small pieces.
Combine all dressing ingredients in a container with a tight-fitting lid.  Shake well to blend, then shake again before using.
Wash and dry greens and place in a large bowl.  Add dressing and toss.  Add raspberries, cheese, and almonds; toss lightly and serve immediately.  Serves 12 (or more).*

title: Smoked Salmon Breakfast Casserole
source: Annapolis Bed and Breakfast Association, Favorite Recipes, Volume 2; recipe from Royal Folly

ingredients.ingredient: ½ lb. sliced smoked salmon, cut into 1" pieces
8 oz. cream cheese, chilled, cut into ¼" to ½" pieces
8 large eggs (used 4 whole eggs plus 8 egg whites)

steps: Spray a 13" x 9" x 2" baking dish with cooking spray.  Arrange broccoli and half of green onions evenly over bottom of dish.  Sprinkle with salmon, Swiss cheese, cream cheese, and remaining half of green onions.
Mix eggs, milk, baking mix, and pepper in blender until smooth.  Pour batter over salmon mixture.  Bake at 375° until just set in center, about 45 – 55 minutes.  Let cool 10 minutes before serving.

To prepare a day in advance:  Complete first paragraph above.  Cover and refrigerate.  Combine remaining ingredients except baking mix in blender jar and refrigerate.  To bake, remove baking dish and blender jar from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.  Add baking mix to blender and continue as above.

title: Fish Fillets Parmesan

ingredients.ingredient: juice of half of a lemon

steps: Place fillets in a well-greased shallow baking dish.
Pour juice over fillets.
Melt butter in a saucepan and stir in flour.
Add seasonings.
Gradually add milk to flour mixture.  Cook over low heat, stirring constantly, until thickened.
Put mushrooms over fillets, then half of sauce, then cheese, then other half of sauce.
Bake at 350° for about 20 minutes.

title: Fish With Tomato Mustard Sauce
source: Sue Sukonick in Beth David's Kvelling in the Kitchen
footnotes: Also made using ~5 pounds of very thick striped bass fillets.  Tripled sauce and baked at 400° for ~30 minutes.

ingredients.ingredient: 4 6-oz. - 8-oz. pieces of fish fillets, such as mahi mahi or salmon, or swordfish steaks

steps: Combine all ingredients and pour over fish.
Bake at 350° for ~20 minutes.*

title: Tuna With Tamari and Ginger
source: Louisa's Cafe in Cape May, NJ
footnotes: Also used half recipe to marinate 1 pound mahi mahi fillet.  Baked at 400° for ~12 minutes.  Served 3.
Also microwaved ¾ pound of mahi mahi on high for 10 minutes. Served 2.

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. rice vinegar or cider vinegar
½ tsp. hot pepper flakes (use less if too hot)

steps: To make marinade, combine all ingredients except tuna.
Add tuna and marinate, covered, in refrigerator 1 - 2 hours.
Grill ~3 - 4 minutes per side so it is still pink in the middle.* *

title: Greek Scampi
footnotes: Doubles well.

ingredients.ingredient: ½ lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined
2 tsp. chopped fresh dill (or ¾ tsp. dried)

steps: Sauté garlic in oil briefly.
Add shrimp.  Cook on medium heat for one minute.
Add tomatoes, feta, lemon juice, and dill.  Stir so that the shrimp cook on both sides.
When the shrimp are pink and the tomatoes and feta have made a sauce, it's ready.
Sprinkle with pepper and serve at once over rice, couscous, or orzo.*

title: Shrimp Calypso

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. large or jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
¼ c. sweetened shredded coconut, toasted
⅓ - ½ large mango, peeled, pitted, and cut into ½" cubes

steps: Place shrimp in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, combine the next 6 ingredients.
Sprinkle mixture over shrimp and toss well.
Cover and refrigerate until needed.
Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat.
Add peas and toss; sauté for a minute or 2.
Add shrimp and sauté until shrimp turn pink, ~2 minutes.
Add wine and orange juice and cook until almost all the liquid is absorbed.
Add mango and cook until it is just heated through, 1 minute more.
Remove pan from heat and stir in cilantro.
Sprinkle with coconut.

title: Crab Cakes with Shrimp
footnotes: You can make the cakes a bit smaller to feed 6.  Or you can increase the amount of each ingredient by ⅓.  (See measurements in parentheses.)
This can be done 2 - 3 hours in advance.  Cover and chill.
Can also be made into small cakes and served as hors d'oeuvres.
This is good with the Mango Puree.  See recipe in "Sauces and Dressings."

ingredients.ingredient: ¾ lb. shrimp, shelled and deveined (1 lb.)
1 egg (1 whole egg and 1 egg white)
1 tbsp. Dijon-style mustard (1 tbsp. and 1 tsp.)
½ c. finely chopped green onions, ~1 bunch (⅔ c.)
1 lb. jumbo lump crab meat, picked over for shells (1⅓ lb.)

steps: Put shrimp, egg, cream, salt, pepper, mustard, and Worcestershire and Tabasco sauces in a food processor.
Blend as finely as possible.
Pour into a mixing bowl and add green onions.
Gently but thoroughly fold in crab meat.
Shape into 10 cakes.* *
Heat oil on a griddle or in a skillet and add the cakes.
Cook over medium heat ~3 minute on each side or until golden brown.**

title: Flounder With Parmesan Crust
footnotes: If you have a lot of thin little fillets, you can make 2 layers, coating each layer.
Halves well.
steps: Spray broiler pan with nonstick spray.
In a small bowl combine all ingredients except fish.
Spread a small amount of mixture on 1 side of fillets and arrange them, coated side down, on the broiler pan.
Spread remaining yogurt mixture over fillets.*
Broil ~ 8"from heat until done, ~6 - 8 minutes.*

title: Salmon With Orange-Ginger Sauce
footnotes: Alternatively, you can place fish skin-side down on a broiler pan coated with vegetable spray.  Cook 5" - 6" from heat for 10 - 13 minutes.
steps: Cut fish into 4 - 6  equal pieces.
Place salmon skin-side down in a shallow dish that has been sprayed with vegetable cooking spray.
Combine remaining ingredients.  Pour over fish.
Marinate in refrigerator for 45 minutes.
Drain fish, reserving marinade.
Grill fish 5 - 6 minutes per side until done.*
Place fish on warm serving platter.
Bring reserved marinade to a boil in a saucepan.
Cook 3 minutes.  Pour over fish.

title: Easy Gefilte Fish

ingredients.ingredient: 2 large onions, sliced, leaving skins on
12 pieces of Old Vienna (Rokeach) gefilte fish in sweet jelly
4 - 6 carrots, scraped and cut into large slices

steps: Put onions in a large pot.
Top with a layer of fish.  Sprinkle generously with paprika and pepper.
Sprinkle with carrots.  Pour sweet jelly over.
Bring to a boil.  Simmer, covered 35 - 45 minutes, turning halfway through and sprinkling with more paprika and pepper.
Remove fish and carrots from broth and chill.

title: Lemon-Glazed Asparagus

ingredients.ingredient: ½ c. chicken broth (or parve "chicken broth" or vegetable broth)

steps: Steam asparagus until tender-crisp.  Drain and pat dry.
Combine remaining ingredients in a small saucepan.  Boil until reduced to ~3 tbsp.
Brush over asparagus.  Serve warm or at room temperature.
