title: Spinach Strawberry Salad

ingredients.ingredient: 2 lb. fresh spinach, cleaned and trimmed of stems
1 pt. strawberries, washed, hulled and sliced or halved

steps: Place spinach, strawberries, and almonds in a large bowl.
Place remaining ingredients in a jar.  Cover and shake.
Pour onto spinach and toss.

title: Sugar-and Nut-Glazed Brie
footnotes: If frozen, let stand at room temperature 1 hour before proceeding.
Halves well.  Use 8-ounce round of Brie.

ingredients.ingredient: crackers, French bread (baguette) slices, grapes, apple wedges brushed with lemon juice

steps: In a small mixing bowl stir together sugar, nuts, and whiskey or brandy.
Cover; chill up to 1 week or freeze up to 6 months*
Put cheese on a large round ovenproof platter or a 9" pie plate.
Bake at 500° for 4 - 5 minutes or until cheese is slightly softened.
Spread sugar mixture over top.
Bake 2 - 3 minutes more or until sugar is melted and cheese is heated through but not melted.
Serve with remaining ingredients listed.*

title: Mini Brie Tarts
footnotes: Use your imagination to create other combinations of flavors.
Number of servings varies according to how many shells are used.

ingredients.ingredient: dried cherries, dried cranberries, or fresh raspberries

steps: Cut Brie into small chunks.  Place into shells.
Top with a dollop of preserves and then a berry.
Sprinkle with nuts.  Heat at 350° until warm and cheese softens* *

title: Curried Shrimp Phyllo Cups

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. finely chopped unsalted peanuts
½ tsp. grated ginger root or ¼ tsp. ground ginger
2 pkg. of mini phyllo cups (15 cups per pkg.)

steps: Cook shrimp in boiling water ~4 minutes.  Drain; peel and chop into small chunks.
For filling, in small mixing bowl stir together remaining ingredients except cups.  Gently stir in shrimp.
Fill cups with filling and bake at 375° for ~8 minutes.  Makes 30 cups.

title: Baked Artichoke and Crab Spread

ingredients.ingredient: 1 14-oz. can artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps: Combine first 4 ingredients in a bowl.
Transfer to an 8½" x 5" baking dish.  Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake at 325° until top is browned, ~30 minutes.
Serve hot with crackers and/or baguette slices.

title: Easy Baked Eggs
footnotes: Halves well.

ingredients.note: You can substitute 2 egg whites per whole egg for some of the eggs.  I use 6 whole eggs and 12 egg whites.

ingredients.ingredient: 1½ c. crumbled cooked bacon (~14 - 16 strips),  cut up Canadian bacon (~½ lb.), or cut up cooked shrimp
3 c. shredded cheese (Cheddar, Swiss, Jarlsberg, Monterey Jack, or a blend)*
ingredients.note: I use 2 cups Swiss and 1 cup sharp Cheddar.

steps: Melt butter in a small skillet over medium-low heat.  Saute onions and mushrooms until soft.
In a large mixing bowl, beat eggs.
Add all other ingredients except ½ cup of the cheese.
Pour into a greased ovenproof rectangular 2-quart casserole.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes or until mixture is set.  (It may take 45 - 50 minutes.)
Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Continue to bake until cheese melts.*

title: Crustless Quiche
steps: Mix all ingredients together.
Pour into a 9" casserole dish.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 30 minutes.
You may want to let it set a bit before serving.

title: Bauern Farm-Style Shirred Eggs

ingredients.ingredient: 6 slices boiled ham or Canadian bacon
18 cherry tomatoes or 6 slices of a large tomato
freshly ground pepper (and salt, if desired)
¾ c. light cream or half-and-half

steps: Butter 6 ramekins and place a bread slice on the bottom of each.
Cover each with a slice of Swiss cheese, then a slice of ham or bacon.
Break an egg into each ramekin.
Arrange 3 halved cherry tomatoes (or 1 slice of regular tomato cut into 6 pieces) around each egg.  Sprinkle with seasonings.
Pour 2 tbsp. cream over each egg.  Sprinkle with grated Swiss cheese.
Bake at 350° for 15 - 20 minutes or until eggs set.

title: Raspberry Vinaigrette

ingredients.ingredient: 3 tbsp. cider vinegar or Balsamic vinegar

ingredients.note: Used olive oil

steps: Combine vinegar, raspberries, and honey in food processor and blend.
Pour oil through feed tube in a thin stream while processor is running.  Adjust seasonings.

title: Dried Fruit Charoset

ingredients.ingredient: ⅓ c. slivered or sliced almonds

steps: In saucepan combine dried fruit bits, coconut, cinnamon, ½ c. red wine, and water.  Bring to boiling; reduce heat.  Cover and simmer about 25 minutes or until the dried fruit is tender and liquid is absorbed.

Place half the fruit mixture in a food processor or blender.  Cover and process or blend until smooth.  Stir into remaining fruit mixture along with the 2 tbsp. wine.  Cover and store in frig. up to 2 weeks.
Before serving, stir in almonds, which have been toasted by placing in 350˚ oven for 10 minutes and stirring occasionally until golden.

title: European Fruit Pudding
footnotes: Can be prepared in advance and baked later.

ingredients.note: Low Cholesterol version:  use 2 whole eggs and 8 egg whites

steps: Soak apricots, prunes, and peaches in hot water for 1 hour; drain.
Cut fruit into pieces.
Beat eggs, add oil, then sugar, then cake meal.
Mix thoroughly.  Add fruit with a wooden spoon and mix thoroughly.
Turn into greased 9" x 12" baking pan.  Sprinkle with cinnamon.
Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until browned on top.*

title: Sweet Passover "Muffins"

ingredients.ingredient: 2 c. grated peeled apple (about 2 apples) (prefer Granny Smith)
2 c. matzo cake meal (or matzo meal)
¾ c. (1½ sticks) butter or Passover margarine, melted

steps: Mix all together.
Grease 24 muffin tins or a 9" x 13" pan.  (If non-stick pans, may not need to grease.)  Pour in batter.
Cover with foil and bake at 325˚ for 30 minutes for muffins or 45 minutes for 9" x 13" pan.
Uncover and raise heat to 350˚.  Bake another 15 minutes.  (Doesn’t rise.)
Halves well.

title: Spinach and Pepperoni Quiche
footnotes: If prepared ahead, refrigerate or freeze filling separately from crust.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 large red sweet pepper, coarsely chopped
half of a 10-oz. pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
1 c. shredded Monterey Jack cheese (4 oz.)
2 oz. sliced pepperoni, cut into strips (¼ c.)
¼ c. light cream or milk

steps: In a medium skillet cook sweet pepper in hot oil until crisp-tender; drain.
Separate crescent rolls into triangles.  Press over bottom and ¾”up sides of a 9 or 9½”tart pan or quiche dish, pressing dough together at perforations.
In a medium mixing bowl combine sweet pepper, eggs, spinach, cheeses, pepperoni, cream or milk, and pepper.
Pour into crust-lined pan.*
Bake at 350° for 30 minutes or until set.

title: Mexican Dip

ingredients.ingredient: 1 10-oz. box frozen chopped spinach, thawed and drained

steps: Blend all ingredients together.
Pour into a greased deep dish pie plate.
Bake at 400° for 20 - 25 minutes.  Serve with tortilla chips or cut-up vegetables.

title: Chicken Liver Pâté

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. currants, soaked in brandy or water and drained

steps: In a saucepan, barely cover livers with water.  Bring to a boil, then simmer for 15 minutes; drain.
Process in food processor.  Add remaining ingredients except currants and blend well.
Stir in currants by hand.
Pack into a crock or pretty bowl and chill well.

title: Chopped Liver Pâté With Chutney
footnotes: Variation:  Eliminate eggs.  Process pâté until smooth.  Stir in ¼ cup currants (or more) soaked in brandy or liqueur (used Triple Sec) and drained.  I halved the variation version of the recipe and it made ~2 cups.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. chicken livers, trimmed of excess fat and halved
2 large white onions (~1 lb.), finely chopped
½ c. + 2 tbsp. mango or other fruit chutney
2 large hard-cooked eggs, cut in 4 - 8 pieces each

steps: Preheat broiler.  Lightly grease a broiler pan and arrange livers in a single layer in the pan.  Broil 8 - 10 minutes, turning once.  Cool.
Heat oil in a large (12") skillet over medium heat.  Sauté onions, stirring frequently, until golden brown, ~10 minutes.  Cool.
Combine livers and ½ cup chutney in food processor.  Process, using pulsing, until combined but still chunky.
Add eggs, pepper, and onions and process until combined but a bit coarse.  Transfer to serving dish, cover and refrigerate.
To serve, spread remaining 2 tbsp. chutney over chopped liver.  Serve with crackers or sliced baguette.

title: Curried Crab Dip

ingredients.ingredient: ½ lb. crabmeat (I used lump backfin), picked over for shells

steps: Line a large strainer with a double thickness of cheesecloth and place over a medium bowl.
Spoon yogurt into the strainer.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.  Discard any liquid in the bowl.  (May need to check and discard a few times.)
In a bowl combine drained yogurt, crabmeat, green onion, chutney, curry powder, and red pepper.
Serve with carrots, cucumber, or crackers.  Especially good with Kame plain rice crunch crackers.

title: Butternut Squash Soufflé

ingredients.note: To save time, you can use packaged fresh butternut squash that has been peeled, seeded, and cut into chunks.

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. brown sugar, firmly packed

steps: Cut squash in half lengthwise.  Remove seeds and stringy portion.
Place squash, cut side down, in 1 inch of boiling salted water in a kettle.  Bring back to boiling; cover.
Cook 15 minutes or until tender.  Drain on paper towels.
Scoop pulp into bowl with a spoon.  Discard shells.
Mash squash.  Heat oven to 375°.
Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat.  Add flour; cook 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add milk syrup, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.  Stir until thick and smooth.
Remove from heat.  Add egg yolks, one at a time, beating well after each addition.
Mix in squash and sugar.
Beat egg whites stiff but not dry.  Stir about ½ cup egg whites into squash to lighten it.  Fold squash into remaining egg whites gently.
Turn into buttered 1½-quart soufflé dish.  Smooth with spatula.
Bake 35 - 40 minutes.

title: Mushrooms Florentine
footnotes: Can be doubled and cooked in an 11” x 14” pan.

ingredients.ingredient: 2 10-oz. pkg. frozen chopped spinach, thawed and well drained
¼ c. melted butter or margarine

steps: Combine spinach, onions, pepper, and margarine; spread in a 10”casserole.
Sauté mushrooms in a non-stick skillet sprayed with cooking spray until mushrooms are brown; drain.
Sprinkle ½ cup cheese over spinach.  Arrange mushrooms on top and season with garlic powder.  Cover with remaining cheese.
You can cover and refrigerate it until ready to bake.
Bake at 350° for 20 minutes.*

title: Mushrooms and Asparagus

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. asparagus, woody bases snapped off and discarded

steps: Sauté garlic in butter.  Add mushrooms, cooking quickly.
Remove mushrooms and garlic from pan, leaving butter and juices from mushrooms.
Place asparagus in pan and cover, steaming asparagus until tender, about 6 - 8 minutes.
Add soy sauce and mushrooms.
Heat long enough for mushrooms to be tender but still crisp.

title: Roasted Asparagus

ingredients.note: Use vegetable broth if you want a vegetarian dish.

steps: Snap off and discard woody bases of asparagus spears.
Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet.  Spray asparagus with vegetable oil spray.
Bake at 500° for 10 minutes or until crisp-tender and lightly browned.  Remove from oven.
Combine remaining ingredients in a jar.  Cover and shake until well blended.
Drizzle over cooked asparagus and toss gently to coat.  Serve at once, let cool, or chill.

title: Orange, Onion, and Avocado Salad

ingredients.ingredient: 2 heads Boston lettuce, washed, dried, and chilled in damp towels
3 - 4 navel oranges, peeled and thinly sliced
½ c. coarsely chopped walnuts, sautéd in 1 - 2 tbsp. oil

steps: _Make dressing_:  Put all ingredients except oil in blender or food processor and mix well.
With blender running, add oil in a slow stream until incorporated.
_Arrange salad_:  Place lettuce leaves on individual salad plates and top with alternate slices of onion, oranges, and avocado.  Sprinkle with walnuts.
Spoon dressing over salads and serve at once.

title: Pear Salad
footnotes: Dressing can be made ahead and refrigerated.
Can add crumbled goat cheese or feta.

ingredients.ingredient: 10 oz. baby spring greens or baby spinach
¼ c. dried cherries or dried cranberries
2 medium ripe pears, cut into thin slices
ingredients.note: Works well with apples or a combination of pears and apples.

ingredients.ingredient: ½ tsp. each:  Worcestershire sauce, dried basil, oregano, sugar

steps: Whirl all dressing ingredients in a food processor or blender until smooth.*
Pour over greens and toss.
Toss cherries pears, and nuts with dressing and place over greens.*

title: Roasted Butternut Squash Salad

ingredients.ingredient: 20 oz. peeled and cut up butternut squash
1 tbsp. finely chopped shallots or red onion

steps: Cover dried cranberries with port and let sit overnight (or at least for a few hours).
Dice squash into small pieces; slice red onion.  Mix with olive oil and maple syrup, season with pepper and roast in a 400° oven for 25 – 35 minutes until squash is cooked and onions browned.
_Sherry Maple Vinaigrette:_ Combine vinegar, mustard, maple syrup, and shallots in a bowl (I used mini-prep food processor). Slowly whisk in oil.  Season with pepper.

Toss greens with some vinaigrette and arrange on plates or a large platter. Top each plate of greens with squash and onions.  Drain cranberries and sprinkle them and pecans on top.  Garnish with goat cheese and drizzle more vinaigrette.
All parts can be prepared the day before.  Bring to room temperature and assemble just before serving.

title: Dijon Baked Salmon

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. nonfat yogurt or lowfat sour cream

steps: Combine first 3 ingredients.
Brush on salmon.   If using steaks, brush on both sides.
Place salmon in a baking dish and bake at 425° for 10 minutes.
Optional:  Place under broiler and brown before serving.

title: Apple French Toast
source: Breakfast at Nine Tea at Four, Favorite Recipes from the Mainstay Inn, Cape May, NJ by Sue Carroll

ingredients.ingredient: 2 Granny Smith apples, peeled and sliced
1 loaf French bread or cinnamon raisin bread

steps: Cook sugar, butter, and syrup until syrupy.  Pour into a 9" x 13" baking dish.
Cover with all the apple slices.
Slice bread into ¾" slices, remove crusts all around, and place in a single layer on top of apple slices.  Squeeze to fit.
Whisk together remaining ingredients and pour over bread.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Bake uncovered for 40 minutes at 350°.  Cut into squares and spoon sauce from bottom over.

title: Autumn Bisque

ingredients.ingredient: 1 Granny Smith apple, peeled, cored, and chopped
1½ c. chicken stock or vegetable broth
6 oz. frozen apple juice concentrate, thawed*
ingredients.note: You can use ½ c. apple cider instead.

steps: Melt margarine in a pot and add onions and curry.  Cook, covered, over low heart until onions are tender, ~25 minutes.
Meanwhile, peel squash, scrape out seeds, and chop flesh.
When the onions are tender, pour in the stock, add squash and apples and bring to boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, partially covered, until squash and apples are very tender, ~25 minutes.
Pour soup into a strainer, reserving liquid, and transfer solids to food processor with the steel blade.  Add 1 cup cooking liquid and process until smooth.
Return soup to pot and add apple juice concentrate and remaining cooking liquid (up to 1 cup).
Stir in heavy cream to taste.  Simmer briefly to heat through.
Can be made ahead, chilled, and reheated.   Freezes well.

title: Pasta with Caper Vinaigrette

ingredients.ingredient: 1 lb. rigatoni, fusilli, or penne pasta, cooked, drained, and cooled
2 large tomatoes or 6 - 8 Italian plum tomatoes, peeled, seeded, and diced
1½ c. loosely packed parsley, stems removed

steps: Place pasta, tomatoes, and feta in a large serving bowl.
Place garlic, pepper, parsley, capers, and vinegar in a food processor.  Process into a paste.
With food processor running, add oil.
Pour over pasta and toss.  Allow to stand at room temperature for 1 hour before serving; toss again.

title: Potato Latkes
footnotes: I use food processor to grate.

ingredients.ingredient: 8 oz. Philadelphia Lite cream cheese, softened
ingredients.note: To soften cream cheese quickly, place in microwave-safe bowl and microwave on high for 15 seconds.

steps: In a large bowl, thoroughly mix cream cheese, eggs, flour, pepper, onion powder, and salt.  Beat until smooth.
Stir in Swiss cheese.
Peel and grate potatoes.  Squeeze out excess moisture a handful at a time and discard liquid.*
Stir grated potatoes into cheese mixture.
Form into 3-inch patties.
Cover bottom of griddle or large skillet with a thin coating of oil.  Fry pancakes over moderately high heat until lightly browned on each side.  Drain on paper towel.
Serve immediately or cool, wrap, and refrigerate or freeze.
If cooked ahead, reheat, uncovered, at 350° for 15 minutes or until hot.

title: Parmesan Potatoes

ingredients.note: Alternatively, you can use 4 - 6 medium white potatoes.

steps: Dice potatoes (don’t peel) and pat dry.
Melt margarine and oil in a large skillet.  Add potatoes.  Cover and cook, stirring frequently, until tender, about 7 - 8 minutes.
Stir in cheese and transfer to a shallow 2-quart casserole.  Sprinkle with more cheese and with paprika.
Bake at 350° for 30 - 45 minutes until golden and crispy.

title: Herb Roasted Potatoes Dijon
footnotes: This is a lot of mustard sauce.  You could try making ⅔ of the recipe or use 3 pounds of potatoes instead.

ingredients.ingredient: 6 medium red skin potatoes (~2 lb.), cut into chunks (don’t peel)

steps: Mix all ingredients except potatoes in a small bowl.*
Place potatoes in a lightly greased 13” x 9” x 2” baking pan or a shallow baking sheet; toss with mustard mixture.
Bake at 425° for 35 - 40 minutes or until potatoes are fork tender, stirring occasionally.

title: Cocoa Mocha
steps: Melt chocolate with condensed milk in the top of a double boiler over low heat, stirring occasionally.  Cool.
Fold whipped cream into cooled chocolate mixture.
To serve:  Put ¼ c. of mixture into a mug.  Fill to the top with hot coffee.  Stir and serve.
Store any remaining mixture covered in the refrigerator for up to 1 week.

title: Apricot Brandy Swizzler
steps: Using a blender, blend lemonade and orange juice concentrates and ice.
Add club soda and brandy just before serving.

title: Wild Rice-Mushroom Casserole

ingredients.ingredient: 2¾ c. reduced-sodium, reduced-fat chicken broth (or beef or vegetable)

ingredients.note: I used Lundberg Wild Blend of wild and brown rices.

ingredients.ingredient: ½ tsp. dried thyme or rosemary leaves, crumbled

steps: Preheat oven to broil.  Place mushrooms, stem side down, on baking sheet lined with foil.
Broil until lightly browned, about 4 minutes.  Remove and cool slightly and then dice.
In medium saucepan heat oil.  Sauté shallots until softened, about 4 minutes.
Stir in broth, mushrooms with any juices, rice, thyme, pepper, and bay leaf.
Transfer to a 1½ - 2 quart casserole.  Cover; bake at 350° until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender but still slightly chewy, about 1 hour to 1½ hours.  Discard bay leaf.

title: Mediterranean Feta Cheese Dip
source: Easy Gourmet-style Cooking with 5 Ingredients by Deborah Anderson

ingredients.ingredient: 1 4-oz. jar marinated sun-dried tomatoes, drained, reserving 3 tbsp. marinade oil
4 heaping tbsp. mayonnaise (do not use low-fat)

steps: In a food processor or blender, blend together all the ingredients until they reach a nice consistency to spread on crackers.  Place in medium serving dish and garnish with fresh basil leaf and sun-dried tomato.  Serve at room temperature with crackers.  Makes about 2 cups.
Used leftover to make "tea sandwiches."

title: Zena Wheeler’s Tomato Chutney
source: Anne Webb (Zena Wheeler’s daughter) in Best of Friends II

ingredients.ingredient: ½ lb. green tomatoes or tomatillos

steps: Slice tomatoes.  Put all ingredients in a 3-quart pot.
Bring to a boil.  Reduce heat and simmer slowly, stirring occasionally, until of a thick consistency, about 2 hours.
Serve with poultry or meat.

title: Mushroom-Barley Chowder
source: Better Homes and Gardens Healthy & Delicious Cooking
footnotes: If using regular pearl barley, heat broth, barley, basil, and pepper to boiling; simmer, covered, for 35 minutes.  Add green onions and mushrooms.  Then continue from Step 2.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 14-oz. can reduced-sodium chicken or vegetable broth

ingredients.note: If using regular pearl barley, see note below.

steps: In a large saucepan (used 3-quart) combine mushrooms, broth, green onion, barley, basil, an pepper.  Bring to boil.*
Reduce heat; cover and simmer ~10 minutes or until barley is tender.
Stir in corn and milk.
Cook and stir until heated through.

title: Shrimp, Papaya, and Mesclun Salad with Sweet-and-Sour Vinaigrette
footnotes: The vinaigrette is so good that I would save time and buy cooked shrimp and toss it with the vinaigrette.
Alternatively, you can toss everything together in a large bowl.

ingredients.ingredient: ½ - 1 papaya, peeled, seeded, and cut into ½”cubes
1 small red bell pepper, seeded and cut into ½” triangles
½ Japanese (or other) cucumber, seeds scraped, cut into ½” cubes
½ c. macadamia nuts, roasted and cut in ½
½ tsp. Chinese or Thai chili sauce

steps: Heat sesame oil in a non-stick pan.  Sauté shrimp in the oil, ~2 - 4 minutes, until flesh turns coral pink.  Set aside.*
Combine vinaigrette ingredients in a jar and shake vigorously.
Toss greens with the vinaigrette.  Place equal amounts on 4 - 6 plates.
Arrange shrimp, papaya, red pepper, cucumber, and nuts on top.*

title: Noodled Butternut Squash with Arugula and Goat Cheese

ingredients.note: Used freshly ground store-bought garlic-pepper combination

steps: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat and sauté butternut noodles until al dente, 4 - 6 minutes.
Remove from heat and toss with arugula, pine nuts, and tomato.  Season with pepper to taste.
Drizzle with vinaigrette and toss again.  Top with goat cheese.

title: Nova and Egg Strata
source: Divine Kosher Cuisine by Rise Routenberg and Barbara Wasser, Congregation Agudat Achim, Niskayuna, NY

ingredients.ingredient: 8 cups challah, cut into small pieces (used most of a round Zomick’s challah)
4 oz. sliced Nova smoked salmon, cut into small pieces
2 cups shredded Swiss or Monterey Jack cheese (used Swiss)
8 large eggs, beaten (used 4 whole eggs and 8 egg whites)
¼ cup butter, melted and cooled (used Smart Balance)

steps: Place challah in a greased 9" x 13" baking dish and top with Nova, cheese, and chives.  Combine eggs and remaining ingredients and pour over Nova mixture.  Press ingredients down, to moisten thoroughly.  Cover and chill overnight.
Bake uncovered at 350° for 40 – 45 minutes or until set and edges are puffed and golden.  Let stand 10 minutes before cutting.
_Variation:_

Halved recipe and baked in Cape May quiche dish.  Used 4 thick slices (~½ of a loaf) of Trader Joe’s French brioche instead of challah; ~12 cooked 50 – 60-count shrimp, cut up, instead of Nova; and Italian blend (6 cheeses) instead of Swiss.  Served 6.

title: Gefilte Fish Mold
source: Ethel Hofman in More Savory Secrets from Beth David Sisterhood
footnotes: Do not refrigerate in baking bowl or it will be difficult to remove.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 large carrot, coarsely grated (grate in food processor)
2 lb. fish fillet (carp, whitefish, sea trout, haddock, cod, or a combination), ground (use food processor)*
ingredients.note: 6 lb. whole carp yielded 4½ lb. fillet; 7 lb. carp plus 2 lb. whitefish yielded 3¼ lb. ground fish.

steps: Lightly oil a 1½-quart ovenproof bowl.
Line the bowl with 2 strips of wax paper (criss-cross), long enough to have a generous overhang; brush with oil.
Combine fish,  egg, ice water, matzo meal, onion, horseradish, sugar, salt, and pepper; blend well.
In a separate bowl, place ⅓ of fish mixture; fold in carrot.
Fold dill into remaining mixture.
Place ½ the dill mixture in bottom of paper-lined bowl.  Smooth with spoon.
Layer the carrot mixture on top.
Repeat with remaining dill mixture.
Cover with wax paper overhang.
Set bowl in a pan of hot water and bake at 375° for 1½ hours until center is cooked.
Remove and turn out onto platter.  Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve.*

title: Sausage Ragu

ingredients.note: Often called "Italian Strained Tomatoes" in English. The only ingredient should be tomatoes. Avoid ones with added salt.

steps: Dice the carrot, celery and onion to make a "soffritto". You should have equal amounts of all three (dice a large celery stalk, a similar-sized carrot, then the right amount of onion to match). Heat a tall pot over medium high heat with a few tablespoons of olive oil (enough to lightly coat the bottom of the pot). Add the red chili flakes and toast for about a minute to infuse the flavor. Be careful not to burn.
Add the soffritto to the oil and saute until the veggies soften, 3-5 minutes. The mixture should be moist. If the veggies suck up all the liquid, add a little more oil.

Remove the casing from the sausages. Break up the sausage into small pieces. When the veggies are softened/the onion is translucent, add the sausage. Continue to break up into smaller pieces as it cooks. (I find a potato masher to work really well!) The sausage should render some oil, but if the pot gets too dry, add a little more olive oil.
Once the sausage is browned, deglaze the pan with some red wine. How much wine? The amount you pour out of a bottle in 1-2 seconds.

After the wine has reduced and you no longer smell alcohol, add the bay leaf (if you have one) and the tomato paste and stir until well-combined. After about a minute, add the tomato passata, then stir in the chopped oregano. Bring to simmer and let the stove do its magic! Add salt and pepper, to taste.

The longer it cooks, the more the flavors come together. You can get away with cooking it for 15-20 minutes, but if you have the time, let it simmer 1-2 hours. Make sure to keep the heat at a low simmer. You want to see some bubbles but nothing too crazy; you don't want it to burn. Stir every so often. If too much liquid evaporates and the sauce gets too thick, stir in some water or chicken broth to reach the desired consistency.

Beware! The tomato passata can splatter, so a taller pot is preferred. Cover the pot with a splatter guard if you have one. If you don't have a splatter guard and the tomato is jumping out of the pot, you can partially cover the pot, just don't cover it all the way to make sure the steam can escape.

Shortly before you're ready to eat, boil water and cook pasta according to package directions. This sauce is traditionally served with malloreddus, but tastes great on any pasta shape. It is also fantastic on spaghetti squash.

title: Vegetable Soup

ingredients.ingredient: 1 c. large lima beans (dried; soaked in water overnight, if possible)
1½ c. bow tie noodles (or other noodles), uncooked

steps: Put beef in a large (about 6-quart) pot with ½ pot of water.  Bring to a boil.  Remove scum.
Add ingredients (I) and cook a while (maybe 45 minutes or so).
Add ingredients (II).  Cook longer (maybe an hour).
Add celery greens.
Simmer a _total_ of 3 hours over low heat.  Add water if necessary.  Season to taste.

title: Mixed Baby Greens with Pomegranate Vinaigrette

ingredients.ingredient: 1 tbsp. champagne vinegar or white wine vinegar*
ingredients.note: used sherry vinegar

ingredients.ingredient: 1 Fuyu persimmon or ripe pear, thinly sliced*
ingredients.note: used fresh figs

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. toasted or candied walnuts*
ingredients.note: used honey almonds
maybe also sprinkle with goat cheese

steps: To make the vinaigrette, place the pomegranate juice in a small pan and reduce to 2 tbsp. over medium-high heat.
Combine the juice and the remaining vinaigrette ingredients in a small glass jar and shake vigorously to combine.
Place the mixed greens in a large bowl and add half of the vinaigrette, tossing to coat the leaves.  Add more dressing as desired.
Divide the salad between 4 chilled plates and decoratively arrange slices of persimmons or pears atop the greens.
Sprinkle each serving with walnuts and pomegranate seeds and serve immediately.

title: Pumpkin French Toast
source: Annapolis Bed and Breakfast Association, Favorite Recipes, Volume 2; recipe from Harbor View Inn

ingredients.ingredient: 1 cup plus 2 tbsp. dark brown sugar
10 cups day-old French-type bread, cubed (used Trader Joe’s thick-sliced brioche loaf)
½ cup gold or regular raisins

steps: Spray 9" x 13" pan with cooking spray.  Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl.  Gently fold in bread cubes and raisins.  Cover and refrigerate overnight.

Remove dish from frig and bring to room temperature.  Bake at 350° for 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean.  Let stand ~10 minutes; sprinkle with powdered sugar.  Can serve with maple syrup or Caramel Sauce (recipe follows).
_Caramel Sauce:_ Whisk brown sugar and butter in heavy saucepan.  Whisk in cream and stir until sugar is dissolved and sauce is smooth, ~3 minutes.

title: Hoisin Mushroom Phyllo Cups

ingredients.ingredient: 4 green onions, thinly sliced, green & white parts separated

ingredients.note: If you can't find shiitake mushrooms, substitute an additional 8 ounces of crimini mushrooms.

steps: Heat 2 teaspoons olive oil in a large nonstick skillet set over medium-high heat.  Add the white sections of the green onion and ginger.  Cook, stirring, for 1 minute.
Add the remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil to the skillet.  Add the crimini and shiitake mushrooms.  Cook, stirring occasionally, until the mushrooms just start to brown, 7 to 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and ground pepper and cook for 30 seconds.
While the mushrooms are cooking, whisk together the hoisin sauce, soy sauce, honey, and chili garlic sauce.
Pour the hoisin mixture into the skillet with the mushrooms and cook for 1 minute.
Remove from the heat and stir in the green sections of the green onions and the parsley.
Fill each mini fillo shell with 1 tablespoon of the mushroom mixture. Serve.

title: Prosciutto Wrapped Apples with Manchego Cheese
footnotes: Alternatively, you can place on a baking sheet and heat at 350° until done.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 honeycrisp apple, cored and cut into 16 slices
8 slices of prosciutto, cut in half lengthwise*
ingredients.note: Maybe try crosswise

ingredients.ingredient: 3 ounces manchego cheese, sliced about ¼ inch thick and 2 inches long*
ingredients.note: I found one at Giant that was pre-sliced to perfect size.

steps: Take a slice of apple and cheese and wrap a half slice of prosciutto around it. Repeat with remaining apple, cheese slices, and prosciutto.

Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.  Place the wrapped apples in the skillet cut side down and cook until the prosciutto is golden and crispy and the cheese is slightly melted, about 2-3 minutes per side.*
Serve warm, drizzling with honey just before serving.

title: Mango Chicken Curry

ingredients.ingredient: 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or white vinegar
1¼ pounds skinless boneless chicken thighs or breasts, cut into 1-inch pieces
ingredients.note: Also good with shrimp or both chicken and shrimp.

steps: Heat oil in a large sauté pan over medium heat. Add onions and bell pepper and cook, stirring occasionally, until soft, about 5 minutes.  Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute. Add the curry powder and cumin, cook for a few more minutes. The spices will absorb some of the oil, so if anything begins to stick too much to the bottom of the pan, add a little more oil to the pan.

Add the vinegar, coconut milk, and one of the two chopped mangos to the pan. Increase the heat and bring to a boil, then lower the heat to maintain a low simmer for about 15 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove pan from heat. Scoop the sauce into a blender. Purée the sauce, pulsing until smooth. Return the sauce to the pan.
Add chicken and raisins (if using) to the pan and return to a low simmer. Cover the pan and let cook for 8 - 10 minutes. The chicken should be just cooked until done.

Add the remaining chopped mango.  Cook at a very low temperature for another minute or two, uncovered.  If a little too sweet, add a little more vinegar. If not sweet enough, you can add a dash of sugar. Add salt and pepper to taste.  Serve over rice or with Naan for dipping and garnish with cilantro, if desired.

title: Slow Cooker Pernil

ingredients.ingredient: 4 lb pork shoulder or pork butt
ingredients.note: You can use bone-in or boneless
The original recipe calls for white vinegar, but I happened to have prosecco vinegar on hand and it worked great.

steps: Cut several deep incisions into the pork shoulder on all sides.
Place all marinade ingredients (everything but the pork) into a small food processor and pulse until combined into a paste.
Rub pork all over with the marinade, making sure to get inside all the incisions. Cover and refrigerate overnight or a minimum of four hours.
When ready, place in crockpot and cook on low for 8 hours. There is no need to add any liquid, the pork will expel its own juices as it cooks.

Depending on the size of the pork, you may begin to check it after 6-7 hours. The pork is not ready until it easily pulls apart. Once it has reached this state, remove the pork from the crockpot, leaving the liquid in the pot, and place it on a cutting board. Using two large forks, gently pull apart the pork into pieces. As you remove pieces, place them back in the crockpot in the liquid. Reduce heat to warm and serve. This is a great meal for a large group/party, as you can leave it on warm all night without overcooking it.
Serving suggestion: pairs nicely with rice, maduros (sweet plantains) or rice and beans. If serving with rice, be sure to pour some of the pork drippings over the rice for extra flavor!

title: Pesto Genovese

ingredients.note: Basil is most traditional, but you can use a mix of herbs, such as mint, parsley, oregano and/or cilantro.
Pine nuts are most traditional, but try it with pistachios, walnuts, pecans, hazelnuts or almonds. Toast the nuts to bring out the more flavor, but be sure to let cool before using.
Not too much. The cheese is already salty.
Using the ice helps the pesto maintain its green color

steps: Fill up the cup of an immersion blender by making layers of each of the ingredients. You will want to make about four layers of each ingredient. Split each ingredient in quarters, then place a quarter of each ingredient, followed by another quarter of each, etc. until all the ingredients are used up.

Carefully blend all the ingredients except the salt together to make a paste. You will want to take breaks to mix up the ingredients yourself, making sure to get anything on the bottom that may be still whole. Once it's all mixed nicely and all the leaves and nuts are broken down into the paste, taste it, then adjust the levels and add salt, if needed. If you added anything, blend again until fully mixed.

Cover and refrigerate until ready to use. To use a pasta sauce, simply toss over hot cooked pasta. It also goes great as a sauce on chicken or shrimp, as well as with vegetables such as mushrooms. When possible, avoid cooking the pesto, prefering tossing it on already hot cooked food, to avoid separation of the oil.

title: Brussels Sprouts in Lemon Mustard, Recipe #1
steps: Steam sprouts and garlic until tender, about 10 minutes.
Melt butter in medium skillet and stir in juice and mustard.  Add sprouts and garlic and toss.

title: Brussels Sprouts in Lemon Mustard #2
footnotes: To make in advance, chill at this point.  30 minutes before serving, bring to room temperature.  Then continue with recipe, tossing until heated through.

ingredients.ingredient: 1½  lb. Brussels sprouts, stems trimmed, cut in half vertically
½ lb.  baby Portabella mushrooms, sliced

steps: Toss sprouts, mushrooms, olive oil, and pepper in a large bowl.  Spread in a single layer in a rimmed baking sheet.
Preheat oven to 400°.  Add baking sheet and roast for 10 minutes.  Add garlic and toss mixture.
Continue roasting until sprouts are tender, ~10 - 15 minutes longer.*
Melt butter.  Add lemon juice and mustard and stir.  Toss with Brussels sprouts and mushrooms.
If desired, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.

title: Shrimp and Guacamole Canapes

ingredients.note: I have also used seared slices of tuna instead of shrimp.

steps: In a 10”skillet cook shrimp in hot salad dressing over medium-high heat until shrimp turns pink, stirring constantly.  Cool slightly.
Drain shrimp and cut each in half length-wise.
Spread 1 tsp. guacamole on each melba toast round.
Place 1 shrimp half atop each canapé.  Garnish with chopped tomato, fresh chive sprigs, or snipped fresh cilantro.
_Guacamole_
Remove pit from avocado and scoop flesh into a bowl.
Add lemon juice and mash with a potato masher or fork until moderately creamy.  There should still be a few lumps.
Stir in garlic and salsa to taste.
Place piece of plastic wrap directly on surface of guacamole to keep from turning brown.
Refrigerate until ready to use.
Makes ~¾ cup.

title: Mini Brie Tarts

ingredients.ingredient: mini fillo dough shells (in freezer section at market
dried cherries, dried cranberries, or fresh raspberries
nuts—sliced almonds, chopped macadamias, or your favorite nuts

steps: Cut brie into small chunks. Place into shells.
Top with a dollop of preserves and then a berry.
Sprinkle with nuts.
Heat in oven at 350° until warm and cheese softens.

title: Franks in Blankets
footnotes: There will be leftover dough.  Can roll up extra dough with cheese.

ingredients.ingredient: 2 cans Pillsbury lite crescent rolls dough
1 pkg. cocktail franks (preferably lite Kosher franks)

steps: Separate dough into triangles.
Cut each triangle into 2 smaller triangles.
Place frank on dough at shortest side.
Roll up.  Tuck in sides.
Place point-side down on baking sheet.
Bake according to directions on dough.  Serve with mustard for dipping.

title: Spiced Hot Apple Cider
footnotes: It is best to mix with alcohol in the mug when serving rather than spiking it on the stove. Guests can spike it to taste (or skip the booze), the cider will last longer, and the alcohol won't cook off.

ingredients.ingredient: 16 cups pure apple juice or fresh apple cider

ingredients.note: Spiced rum, whiskey or goldschlager all work very well

steps: Add the apple juice/cider to a large pot or crockpot. Remove the peels from the oranges. Juice the oranges into the cider then add the peels, cinnamon sticks, cloves and star anise. Simmer over low heat for at least 5-10 minutes. Cover and keep warm.
To serve, pour into mugs and spike with your favorite booze (if desired).*
This is a perfect crockpot recipe to bring to an indoor or outdoor party.
Leftovers reheat well as long as it hasn't already been spiked. Refrigerate to keep fresh, then reheat on the stove or microwave.

title: Snow Pea Pods with Boursin
steps: Fill a small saucepan with water.  Bring to a boil.
Set up a mixing bowl filled with ice water.
Drop snow pea pods into boiling water.  Remove them as soon as water returns to a boil and immerse them immediately in ice water.
Slice the stem end of pods on the diagonal.
Using a piping bag with a small tip, pipe cheese into blanched pea pods.  Makes 30 hors d’oeuvres.

title: Artichoke Squares

ingredients.note: Can be made with chopped spinach instead of artichokes.

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. fine dry bread crumbs

steps: Drain marinade from one jar of artichokes into skillet.
Drain second jar of artichokes.  Use food processor to chop all artichokes finely; set aside.
Add onion and garlic to marinade in skillet.  Saute until limp, ~5 minutes.
Beat eggs in bowl; add bread crumbs, salt, pepper, oregano, and hot pepper sauce.
Stir in cheese, parsley, artichokes, and onion mixture.
Pour into greased 11”x 7”x 2” baking pan.
Bake at 325° for 30 minutes, or until set.
Let set in pan, then cut in 2” squares.
Serve hot or cold.

title: Shrimp and Guacamole Canapés
steps: In a 10" skillet cook shrimp in hot salad dressing over medium-high heat, stirring constantly, for 3 - 5 minutes or until shrimp turns pink.
Remove shrimp and dressing from heat and cool slightly.  Transfer to a storage container; chill until serving time.
Spread ~1 tsp. guacamole on each melba toast round.
Drain shrimp and cut each in half lengthwise.
Place 1 shrimp half atop each canape.
If desired, garnish with chopped tomato, fresh chive sprigs, or snipped fresh cilantro.
Can cover and chill up to 3 hours before serving.

title: Chilled Mustard-Marinated Shrimp

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ c. minced shallots or onion
2 tbsp. white wine or tarragon vinegar
1½ lb. shrimp, peeled and deveined or 1 lb. cooked and peeled shrimp

steps: In medium bowl, combine all ingredients except shrimp, if using raw.
If using raw shrimp, add raw shrimp to boiling water, reduce heat so water just simmers.  Cook until shrimp is opaque through center, 3 - 5 minutes.
Drain well; add while hot to marinade.
Stir to coat shrimp well.  Cover and refrigerate 2 hours or overnight.

title: Spinach Cheese Triangles

ingredients.ingredient: 1 10-oz. pkg. frozen puff pastry shells, thawed

steps: Cook spinach and drain, pressing out as much liquid as possible.  Cool.
In medium bowl, mix spinach with cheeses, mayonnaise, and seasonings.  Set aside.
Roll each pastry shell into an 8”rectangle and cut each into quarters.

Spread filing diagonally on one half of each piece.  Moisten edges and fold over (stretch if necessary) to enclose filling and form triangle.  Press firmly together with a fork and place on baking sheet.
Bake at 400° for about 10 minutes until puffed and golden brown.  Serve warm.

title: Cheddar-Chutney Spread

ingredients.ingredient: ½ - 1 tsp. curry powder, to taste

steps: Cut cheddar cheese into small cubes and grate in food processor with the steel blade.
Cut cream cheese into small cubes and add to the food processor along with onion, sherry, curry powder, pepper, and a little less that ¼ c. chutney.  Blend until smooth and creamy.
Spread mixture in a shallow dish.  Top with a layer of chutney and sprinkle with slivered almonds.
Cover tightly and refrigerate until well chilled.
Return to room temperature and serve with crackers.

title: Curried Chicken Balls or Vegetable Dip
footnotes: These freeze well, but don’t roll in coconut until thawed.
Alternatively, you can stir in the coconut and serve it as a dip with celery and carrot sticks.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 c. finely chopped carrots (or cooked chicken breast, chopped)
1 tbsp. or more chutney (mango is good)
2 tsp. curry powder, or to taste

steps: Combine cheese and mayo.
Add the rest of the ingredients except coconut.  Chill until firm.
Roll into appetizer-sized balls and roll each ball in coconut.*
Cover and chill at least 24 hours.*

title: Curried Chutney Dip

ingredients.ingredient: 1 tbsp. curry powder or to taste

steps: Finely mince onion and garlic in a food processor.  Scrape mixture into a small skillet in which you have already melted the margarine.
Saute over moderate heat for about 5 minutes until limp and golden.
Blend in curry powder and mellow 2 - 3 minutes over moderate heat.
Scrape into the food processor bowl.  Add remaining ingredients and cream until smooth.
Serve straight away or refrigerate until 30 minutes before serving.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

title: Spirited Artichoke Spread
footnotes: You can cover and freeze at this point up to 1 month.  To defrost, microwave on low (30%) uncovered for 20 minutes.

ingredients.ingredient: 1 4-oz. can diced green chili peppers, drained

steps: In a food processor or blender place all artichoke hearts.  Blend until finely chopped.
Turn into  a bowl; add cheese and peppers.
Turn into  1-qt. casserole.*  Microwave, covered, on high for 3 - 5 minutes to heat through, stirring once.
Serve with cocktail rye bread or crackers.

title: Roasted Garlic and Brie Spread
steps: Wrap garlic in foil and bake at 300° for 1 hour.  Let cool slightly and press softened garlic out of skins into food processor.
Add olive oil and cayenne pepper and process to puree and blend.
Remove rind from Brie with sharp knife.
In top of double boiler over hot water, heat cheese until softened.  Do not let water boil or cheese will become stringy.
Transfer cheese to food processor with garlic mixture and puree until smooth.
Transfer to small bowl, cover and refrigerate.
Bring spread back to room temp before serving.  Serve with baguette slices or crackers.

title: Mediterranean Torta

ingredients.ingredient: 1 c. oil-packed sun-dried tomatoes (8.5 oz. jar)

steps: Mix cheeses until well blended.  Fold in nuts.  Set aside.
Blot tomatoes dry on paper towels; mince in food processor or with a knife.  Set aside.
For a mold, line a 2-cup round dish with plastic wrap, extending it over the sides by 2 inches.
Cover bottom of dish with ¼ of the tomatoes.  Top with ¼ of the cheese mixture, packing down and smoothing top with back of a spoon.  Cover cheese with a  single layer of basil leaves.
Continue layering the 3 ingredients, ending with cheese.  Make sure to pack cheese down well to seal layers together.
Pull edges of plastic wrap up over cheese; refrigerate for at least 2 hours, until firm.
Open plastic and turn mold out onto serving dish.  Serve with crackers, toasted bread slices, or celery sticks.

title: Artichoke Spread

ingredients.ingredient: 1 15-oz. can packed artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
1 6½-oz. jar marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped
2  oz. diced green chilies (fresh or canned)
¼ c. sour cream (used lowfat or nonfat)
¾ c. grated Parmesan cheese, divided

steps: Combine plain and marinated artichoke hearts, chilies, garlic, cheese, mayonnaise, sour cream, pepper, and ½ cup of Parmesan cheese; blend well.
Spread in oven-proof serving dish.
Sprinkle top with remaining ¼ cup of Parmesan.
Can cover and refrigerate at this point.  Bring to room temperature before continuing.
Bake 15 minutes at 350°.  Serve with crackers.

title: Chili Con Queso
footnotes: This can also be made on top of the stove.

ingredients.ingredient: 2 medium tomatoes, peeled, seeded, and chopped (get rid of any excess juice)
1 4-oz. can green chili peppers, rinsed, well drained, seeded, and chopped OR 2 - 3 hot green peppers
1½ c. shredded cheddar cheese or other sharp cheese

steps: In a microwave oven (MW) cook onion in butter.  If using fresh peppers, add to onions.
MW on high for 1½ minutes.
Stir in tomatoes and canned peppers.
MW 1 minute more on high.
Add cheese in bunches and MW on medium-high until melted.
Taste.  If not spicy enough, add chili powder or cayenne or garlic powder.  If too thick, add a little milk to thin it out.
Serve with tortilla chips.*

title: Russian Mushroom Caviar

ingredients.ingredient: 2 c. finely chopped mushrooms (~ ½ lb.; chop in food processor)
1 c. chopped fresh dill or 1½ tbsp. dried dill

steps: Melt butter in a large, heavy skillet. Add onions and cook about 4 - 5 minutes.
Stir in paprika and cook 1 minute.
Add mushrooms, lemon juice, and salt and pepper to taste.
Cook about 5 minutes , stirring often, until mixture is soft but not dry.
Remove from heat and cool.
When cool, stir in sour cram, dill, and chives.
Refrigerate until serving time.
Serve as a spread with crackers and black bread or cocktail pumpernickel.

title: Classic Risotto

ingredients.ingredient: ¼ cup diced shallots (~½ large shallot)
4 cups low-sodium chicken broth or stock, heated
ingredients.note: 2 cups if using pressure cooker method

ingredients.ingredient: 3 tbsp/14 g Parmigiano Reggiano cheese, grated

steps: This recipe can be prepared on the stove or in an electric pressure cooker. The ingredients and most of the steps are identical for both cooking methods. This style of risotto goes best with seafood, such as shrimp, pan-seared scallops or crab cakes.
If cooking on the stove, heat up 4 cups of chicken stock/broth in a separate pot, and keep heated throughout the cooking process.

Heat olive oil and 2 tbsp butter in a second pot on the stove or on SAUTE setting of the electric pressure cooker. Place the other 2 tbsp of butter back in the fridge to keep it cold. Add the diced shallots and sauté 2-3 minutes. Add the arborio rice and toast for an additional 2-3 minutes.

Add the white wine and gently stir for a few minutes. If making in the pressure cooker, be sure to cook off all the alcohol before moving to the next step (you can tell by smelling it if the alcohol is still present).

_Stovetop:_ Working a ladle (~¼ cup) at a time, add hot broth to the rice and gently stir until well absorbed. Rice does not require constant stirring but should be stirred every 30 seconds.  The broth will initially absorb quickly but towards the end each ladle may take 2-3 minutes. After all broth has been absorbed, remove from heat and let stand, 2-3 minutes.

_Pressure cooker:_ Heat 2 cups of broth in the microwave on high for 1 minute. While this is not required, it should help it come to pressure faster. Once all the alcohol has been cooked off, hit Start/Stop to turn off sauté mode, pour in the broth and give everything a nice stir to make sure nothing sticks to the bottom of the pot. Carefully close and lock the lid and close the pressure seal. Set the pressure cooker to HIGH for 6 minutes. (Reminder: it will take several minutes to come to pressure before the 6 minute timer engages.) When the timer goes off, immediately quick release the pressure. Once all the steam has been released and the lid is unlocked, remove the lid. If, after opening the lid, it appears too liquidy, you may turn it back to saute for a few minutes, stirring gently until it reaches the proper consistency. Turn off and let stand 2-3 minutes.
After thickening for a few minutes, stir in the grated cheese and additional 2 tbsp of cold butter. Serve immediately.

_Optional stir-ins:_ Add some texture and umami by stirring in some sauteed mushrooms and pancetta. After adding the second-to-last ladle of broth on the stove or once the pressure cooker comes to pressure, heat oil in a skillet. Add diced mushrooms and sauté over medium high heat for 4-5 minutes. Add diced pancetta and cook for one more minute, then remove from heat. Stir into the risotto after adding the cheese and butter. For a sweeter iteration, stir in roasted butternut squash cubes and candied pecans or walnuts.

title: Pasta all'Amatriciana
steps: Remove the outer skin/seasoning from the guanciale, and cut into chunks. Make sure each chunk has a mix of meat and fat. Sauté over medium heat until the fat has rendered and the meat is chewy/crispy.

Once the guanciale is done, deglaze the pan with white wine, stirring to combine with the rendered guanciale fat. With a slotted spoon, remove most of the guanciale and set aside, leaving behind all the wine/fat and some guanciale for added flavor (ideally any pieces that didn't cook as quickly).
Add red pepper flakes to the pan. I did not hold back, distributed several shakes around the pan. Use much less if avoiding spice. Cook for about 30 seconds.
Lower the heat and add tomato passata. Be careful it doesn't splatter or burn when adding to the hot oil. Remove from heat at first if needed.
Add 18 cracks of black pepper. Stir often, making sure it doesn't burn. Cook for about 7-10 minutes, no need to reduce too much.

While the passata is simmering, cook the pasta to al dente or slightly less. Reserve some pasta water in case you need it, then add the pasta directly to the sauce. Add a bit of pasta water or broth if the sauce becomes to thick (I haven't needed to do this).

Remove from heat. Stir in the freshly-grated Pecorino and guanciale (or top with guanciale after plating). Divide between two bowls, and top with the reserved guanciale and a little more cheese if you'd like.
Serve immediately.
